title: 第三章　联邦的世界

en: “The mines for the miners” and “Papua for the Papuans” are analytically similar slogans.

zh: “我彻底反对世界政府。”哈耶克在1983年的一次采访中说。当采访者追问“任何形式的吗”，他确认道：“任何形式的。”
如果说今天的美国“奥地利学派”立场有什么确定无疑之处，那就是对政府的不信任——对各个层级的政府皆然，尤其是世界政府。2002年一部关于新自由主义思想与全球化的论文集提出了这样一个二选一：“究竟是自由，还是全球政府，将主宰国际市场？”
更多时候，这个议题干脆无人过问。将近八百页的《奥地利经济学牛津手册》（
）三十四章之中，竟没有一章讨论国际秩序。
然而，无论是这种解读，还是哈耶克本人的说法，面对其早年立场，不是有意否认，就是选择性地遗忘。在1930年代和1940年代初，超国家政府是否可能，对新自由主义者而言根本不成问题——而奥地利学派诸子正是其中最雄辩的辩护者。
en: I’m thoroughly opposed to a world government,” Hayek said in a 1983 interview. When the interviewer pressed by asking “of any form,” he confirmed: “Of any form.”

If there is one certainty about the “Austrian” position in the United States today, it would be a suspicion of government, at all levels, but certainly world government. A 2002 collection on neoliberal thought and globalization posed the binary: “Will freedom or global government dominate the international marketplace?”
More often, the topic is simply ignored. The nearly eight-hundred-page
includes no chapter on international order among its thirty-four chapters.

Yet both this interpretation and Hayek’s own are either conscious disavowal of, or selective amnesia regarding, an earlier position. In the 1930s and early 1940s there was no question for neoliberals that supranational government was a possibility—and Austrians were among its most eloquent defenders.

zh: 也许没有什么比下面这一幕更让自由至上主义者（libertarian）吃惊的了：路德维希·冯·米塞斯的名字竟出现在1941年《纽约时报》（

）的一篇文章里。文章记述世界联谊社（World Fellowship Inc.）在新罕布什尔州一座小镇的世界联谊中心召开的“世界政府大会”。主讲人是美国声名显赫的新古典经济学家欧文·费雪（Irving Fisher）。谈到“希特勒主义”（Hitlerism）这种“战争疾病”，费雪说：“疗法仍是那种过去曾经奏效、也是唯一奏效过的疗法——更多政府。”费雪援引了如今已被遗忘的记者克拉伦斯·斯特赖特（Clarence Streit）那份“详尽的世界政府计划”——此人在1940年代曾短暂地成为世界上最有影响力的知识分子之一——又引用了米塞斯，说米塞斯“愿意在斯特赖特联合各民主国家的计划之外，增添一个覆盖德国与俄国之间广大地带的中欧联合体，把世界政府推迟到日后再造”。
这位晚近自由至上主义运动的偶像，怎么会与设计和创建世界联合体和世界政府的人相提并论？是引错了他的话吗？是他的思想被歪曲了吗？都不是。如我们将看到的，米塞斯、哈耶克、罗宾斯与其他新自由主义者都曾连篇累牍地论述建立强有力的超国家联邦的必要性。
en: Perhaps nothing could surprise the libertarian more than the appearance of Ludwig von Mises in an article in the

in 1941 describing the “world government convention” of the World Fellowship Inc. at the World Fellowship Center in a small town in New Hampshire. The main speaker was Irving Fisher, the celebrated American neoclassical economist. Speaking of the “war-disease” of “Hitlerism,” Fisher said that “the cure is that same cure which has worked before and the only one which has ever worked—more government.” After citing the “detailed plan for a world government” of the now-forgotten journalist Clarence Streit, who was one of the world’s most influential intellectuals for a short time in the 1940s, Fisher cited Mises, “who would add to the Streit plan for uniting democracies a union of Middle Europe covering a wide strip between Germany and Russia, postponing a world government to a later date.”

What was the hero of the latter-day libertarian movement doing in the company of architects of world union and world government? Was he misquoted? Were his ideas distorted? Not at all. As we will see, Mises, Hayek, Robbins, and other neoliberals all wrote extensively about the need for strong supranational federations.

zh: 那些号称小国家先知的人，实际竟主张种种超国家政府，这一看似矛盾的事实当作何解释？第2章已经表明，新自由主义运动诞生于这样一种信念：仅靠周期与数字是不够的。自由主义事业——以及对世界经济优先地位的捍卫——关系太过重大，不能听凭经济学这门学科来打理。诚如勒普克（Röpke）在日内瓦高等国际问题研究院（Graduate Institute）的一次演讲中所言，“世界经济与世界政治并非彼此水不相透的隔舱”。既然两者的“解体”互相牵动，“我们也必须同时加以抗击”。
在欧洲，新自由主义在1930年代兴起时，与其说是一项经济规划，不如说是一项政治与法律的规划。人们上下求索，寻找能从地方到全球各个尺度上最宜围封并保护世界经济空间的治理模式。新自由主义者把这场努力称为反对“干预主义”的战役，但它本身就明明白白是干预主义的。米歇尔·福柯（Michel Foucault）把新自由主义看作“法律干预主义”的规划，看得没错。
这不是极简主义的而是能动主义的治国术愿景：动员国家之力，回击刚刚露头的、由民主赋权的民众之势，以及工会和卡特尔等企图妨碍自由竞争和国际分工的特殊利益集团。
en: How to explain the incongruous fact that the supposed prophets of the small state were actually advocates for varieties of supranational government? Chapter 2 showed how the neoliberal movement was born out of the conviction that cycles and numbers were not enough. The cause of liberalism—and the defense of the primacy of the world economy—was too important to be left to the discipline of economics. As Röpke put it in a lecture at the Graduate Institute in Geneva, “world economy and world politics are no watertight compartments.” Because their “disintegration” was interrelated, “we must also combat them simultaneously.”

In Europe, neoliberalism emerged in the 1930s less as an economic project than as a project of politics and law. The search was on for models of governance, at scales from the local to the global, that would best encase and protect the space of the world economy. Neoliberals described this as a campaign against “interventionism,” but it was clearly interventionist in its own right. Michel Foucault was correct to see neoliberalism as a project of “legal interventionism.”

This was not a minimalist but an activist vision of statecraft mobilized to push back against the incipient power of democratically enabled masses and those special interests, including unions and cartels, who sought to obstruct the free movement of competition and the international division of labor.

zh: 新自由主义者为1930、1940年代的这个敌人起了名字：“经济民族主义”。这个词如今已稀松平常，指政府推行阻碍或迟滞贸易的政策，常由北方口头上的自由贸易论者拿来指向全球南方国家——不论公允与否，这些国家被视为只是全球经济中顽抗不化的参与者。所涉政策包括关税——即对进口征税——也包括非关税贸易壁垒，如健康与安全标准、配额或其他自愿性限制。经济民族主义最早被诊断出的地方不是全球南方，而是后殖民的东欧。新自由主义者是在筛拣前哈布斯堡领土的碎片时首先识别出它的。如我们将看到的，它是新自由主义兴起过程中构成性的“他者”之一：它是他们看待自身政策之方式的一面反影。
en: The neoliberals gave a name to the enemy in the 1930s and 1940s: “economic nationalism.” The term, which today is commonplace, refers to governments enacting policies that block or slow trade, and is often aimed by Northern verbal proponents of free trade at Global South countries that are seen, fairly or unfairly, as only recalcitrant participants in the global economy. The policies at issue could include tariffs—taxes on imports—as well as nontariff barriers to trade, including health and safety standards, quotas, or other voluntary restrictions. Economic nationalism was first diagnosed not in the Global South but in postcolonial Eastern Europe. Neoliberals first identified it while sifting through the shards of the former Habsburg territories. As we will see, it was one of the defining Others for the emergence of neoliberalism: it was the inverted reflection of how they saw their own policy.

zh: 针对经济民族主义这一敌对学说，新自由主义者提出了迈克尔·海尔佩林在1939年国际研究会议（International Studies Conference）的论文中所称的“经济国际主义”。他将其定义为“一种旨在防止政治边界对边界两侧区域之间的经济关系施加任何干扰性影响的政策”。
经济国际主义力求使政治边界徒剩地图上的一线，对商品与资本的流动不生影响。相形之下，经济民族主义追求的则是民族自给自足、闭关自足（autarky）、“隔绝”与“自主”这些误入歧途的目标——后两个词海尔佩林特意加上引号，以示存疑。
在新自由主义者看来，经济民族主义是一场针对相互依存的叛乱，其结局只能是饥饿或扩张战争。全球化已不可逆转。以任何方式把民族经济屏蔽于世界竞争的力量之外，都是有意脱离国际共同体的迹象。
en: Against the enemy doctrine of economic nationalism, neoliberals posed what Michael Heilperin, in his contribution to the 1939 International Studies Conference, called “economic internationalism.” He defined this as “a policy intended to prevent political boundaries from exercising any disturbing effect on economic relations between areas on the two sides of the frontier.”

Economic internationalism sought to make political borders mere lines on the map with no effect on the flow of goods and capital. By contrast, economic nationalism pursued the misguided goals of national self-sufficiency, autarky, “insulation,” and “autonomy”—the latter being categories that Heilperin put in quotation marks to express his skepticism.

Neoliberals saw economic nationalism as a revolt against interdependence that could lead only to starvation or wars of expansion. Globalization could not be undone. To shield a national economy from the forces of world competition in any way was a sign of secession from the international community.

zh: 新自由主义者把问题的根源看作威尔逊主义那两项孪生原则——民族自决（self-determination）与经济自由贸易——之间的紧张。大战之后，世界被切分为越来越小的政治单元，而技术与交换却“朝着统一的、全球性经济体系的方向”推进。
“新自由主义”一词的发明者、法国实业家路易·马利奥（Louis Marlio）在李普曼座谈会（Lippmann Colloquium）上阐明了这道难题：“正是政治疆域的缩小与经济市场需求的与日俱增之间的反差，击碎了自由秩序。”
如何迁就民族主义的现实，同时维系超国家经济秩序的持续要求——新自由主义者面临的挑战正在于此。
en: Neoliberals saw the root of the problem in the tension between the twin Wilsonian principles of national self-determination and economic free trade. After the Great War, the world was segmented into ever smaller political units, even as technology and exchange pushed “in the direction of a unified, world-wide economic system.”

Louis Marlio, the French industrialist who coined the term “neoliberalism,” articulated the conundrum at the Lippmann Colloquium: “It is the contrast between the shrinking of political territories and the ever-increasing necessities of economic markets that broke the liberal order.”
The challenge for neoliberals was how to accommodate the reality of nationalism with the ongoing requirement of a supranational economic order.

zh: 思考帝国之后的世界，首先要清点帝国本身。新自由主义者在此心分两端。一方面，他们谴责这种帝国：把海外领地的管理与对该地资源的优先获取混为一谈，这本身就是一种阴险的经济民族主义变体。另一方面，他们又怅然回望哈布斯堡帝国，因为它据说既平衡了多个民族的要求，又在内部维持着一片经济自由的疆域。他们同样称赞19世纪的大英帝国，因为它在自己的殖民市场里对所有来者保全了自由贸易。这一自由贸易帝国的美好样板，曾由1884—1885年的柏林会议加以推扬：与会欧洲列强立誓合作，保全非洲大陆的自由贸易，并如米塞斯1919年所赞美的，在刚果盆地维持“一切国家经济活动的开放之门”。
门户开放式帝国的精神在国际联盟（League of Nations，简称“国联”）的委任统治制度中延续下来。该制度主张殖民地在超国家机构的监督下渐进走向民族自决。
en: Pondering a world after empire meant first taking stock of empire itself. Neoliberals were of two minds. On the one hand, they condemned the kind of empire that conflated the administration of an overseas territory with preferred access to its resources as itself being an insidious variety of economic nationalism. On the other hand, they looked wistfully back at the Habsburg Empire for supposedly balancing the demands of multiple nationalities while maintaining an internally free economic territory. They also praised the British Empire of the nineteenth century for preserving free trade in its colonial markets for all comers. The laudable model of free-trade empire was promoted at the Berlin Conference of 1884–1885, when the gathered European powers vowed to cooperate to preserve free commerce in the African continent and maintain what Mises praised in 1919 as “the open door for economic activity of all nations” in the Congo basin.

The spirit of Open Door empire lived on in the League of Nations mandate system, which proposed a gradual movement of colonies toward self-determination under the watchful eye of supranational authorities.

zh: 委任统治委员会（Mandates Commission）的主任（1920—1924年）、后来的委员（1924—1939年），正是早期新自由主义的幕后推手威廉·拉帕德（William Rappard）。他是日内瓦高等国际问题研究院（Graduate Institute of International Studies）的院长，1930年代既把米塞斯和勒普克请到日内瓦，又接待了哈耶克与莱昂内尔·罗宾斯的重要系列讲座。正如我们在第2章所见，新自由主义诞生于拉帕德1931年所称的“日内瓦试验”，其信念是“世界统一”的原则必须压倒“绝对国家主权学说那邪恶的愚蠢”。
新自由主义者与国联领导层持有一种共同的信念：需要以超经济手段来保护自由世界经济。执掌国联经济与财政部门的阿瑟·萨尔泰（Arthur Salter）在1934年宣布国际研究会议开幕时说，大萧条使人切身认识到，世界贸易并非自然而然之物，而是“有赖于一个涵盖政治、法律、金融与信贷以及货币制度的世界结构的存在、维系、成长与调适”。
在拉帕德看来，未来自由主义世界政府的种子，已在战间期的日内瓦萌发——国联对奥地利财政的监督、对非洲与亚洲殖民地的委任统治监督开了先河。新自由主义者各自发挥这一主题，想象着帝国的终局将由一个超国家政体来操持：这个政体能够凌驾于国家主权之上，以保护全球自由贸易与资本自由流动。
en: The director (1920–1924) and later member of the Mandates Commission (1924–1939) was the impresario of early neoliberalism, William Rappard, director of the Graduate Institute of International Studies, who brought both Mises and Röpke to Geneva in the 1930s and hosted key lecture series by Hayek and Lionel Robbins in the same decade. As we saw in Chapter 2, neoliberalism was born out of what Rappard in 1931 called the “Geneva experiment,” with its belief that the principle of “world unity” must trump “the wicked folly of the doctrine of absolute national sovereignty.”

Neoliberals shared with the leaders of the League of Nations a belief in the need for extra-economic means to protect the liberal world economy. Arthur Salter, the head of the economics and financial section of the League, opened the International Studies Conference in 1934 by saying that the Great Depression had brought home the realization that world trade was not natural but “depends on the existence, the maintenance, the growth and adaptation of a world structure of politics, law, finance and credit and monetary system.”

Rappard saw the seeds of future liberal world government in interwar Geneva pioneered in the League of Nations oversight over Austrian finances and the mandate supervision of African and Asian colonial territories. In their own variations on this theme, neoliberals imagined the end of empire managed by a supranational state that could override national sovereignty to protect global free trade and free capital flows.

zh: 对新自由主义者而言，1930年代的现实领悟是：自我调节的市场是个神话。世界经济秩序的诸般根基——金本位、通商条约、大英帝国的门户开放政策——阙如得刺眼。若无一致的政治努力，世界经济不会自行再生产。然而，新自由主义者并没有设想重返帝国，而是承认民族国家的时代已不可逆转。秘诀在于：保留民族国家，同时拔掉它的利齿。怎样才能削弱各国扰乱世界经济的能力？他们的梦想是非殖民化，却不要那种毁灭性的经济自主欲望。在伦敦政治经济学院（London School of Economics，LSE），自由派经济学家莫里茨·博恩（Moritz Bonn）针对“帝国的崩解”之后的“世界经济解体”给出了触目惊心的图景；而他的同事哈耶克与罗宾斯则以“世界双重政府”的提案，给出了新自由主义超国家政府最成形的构想。他们提议建立大而松散的联邦：构成联邦的各国保留对文化政策的控制，却须承担义务维护国与国之间的自由贸易与资本自由流动。哈耶克与罗宾斯希望自己的解法既能满足大众对自我代表（self-representation）的要求，又能保全国际分工和对有利可图市场的自由搜寻。他们还直言不讳地希望，自己的联邦图式能釜底抽薪，削弱政府对工业的管理与民众要求的物质财富再分配这两件事成为现实的可能。按照设计，新自由主义者提出的这种去民族化的国家形态，将大到无法计划。
en: The realization of the 1930s for neoliberals was that the self-regulating market was a myth. The foundations of world economic order—the gold standard, commercial treaties, and the Open Door policies of the British Empire—were glaring in their absence. The world economy would not reproduce itself without concerted political effort. Instead of envisioning a return to empire, however, neoliberals acknowledged that the era of the nation was irreversible. The secret was how to keep the nation but defang it. How could nations be sapped of their power to disrupt the world economy? The dream was of decolonization without the destructive desire for economic autonomy. While the liberal economist Moritz Bonn at the London School of Economics provided a striking vision of the “disintegration of world economy” in the wake of the “crumbling of empire,” his colleagues Hayek and Lionel Robbins offered the most developed vision of neoliberal supranational government in their proposal of a double government for the world. They proposed large but loose federations within which the constituent nations would retain control over cultural policy but be bound to maintain free trade and free capital movement between nations. Hayek and Robbins hoped their solution would satisfy mass demands for self-representation while preserving the international division of labor and the free search for profitable markets. They also explicitly hoped that their federal schema would undermine the possibilities of both government administration of industry and popular material redistribution. By design, the denationalized state form proposed by the neoliberals would be too big to plan.

zh: 反殖民化与世界经济

莫里茨·博恩是最早研究后帝国世界经济的理论家之一。他不属于后来组成新自由主义思想运动的群体，却是1930年代经济自由主义领域的一位重量级人物。1933年10月，他在伦敦政治经济学院作了到校后的第一场演讲。邀请他到校的，有罗宾斯、社会主义经济学家哈罗德·拉斯基（Harold Laski），以及时任LSE院长、后来成为英国福利国家设计师之一的威廉·贝弗里奇（William Beveridge）等人。纳粹把身为犹太人的博恩从教席上驱逐出去——此事一度是英国与美国各大报纸的头版新闻——他在LSE的薪俸则靠捐款筹措。
博恩以帝国为研究对象。早在1890年代，他的第一项研究就是爱尔兰：他后来回忆说，自己之所以去那里，是为了“在唯一一个把它保存下来的西方国家里研究落后的经济生活”。
第一次世界大战之前，他前往南部非洲，回到德国后成为殖民地改革的著名发声者，与殖民大臣伯恩哈德·德尔恩堡（Bernhard Dernburg）同台演说——不是反对帝国，而是主张另一种帝国：反对种族混血（
），反对在他看来混血所滋生的难以治理的人口；主张建立一支规模精干的纯白人公务员队伍，保护土著利益，引导他们进入自由劳动与创业的现代世界。
他把英属巴苏陀兰（Basutoland）树为正面样板，与德属西南非洲相对照。
en: Moritz Bonn was one of the most precocious theorists of the world economy after empire. He was not part of the group that would become the neoliberal intellectual movement but was a towering figure in economic liberalism in the 1930s. In October 1933 he gave his first lecture at the London School of Economics (LSE). He had been invited to the school by, among others, Robbins, the socialist economist Harold Laski, and William Beveridge, who was the LSE’s director and later one of the architects of the British welfare state. The Nazis had expelled Bonn, a Jew, from his academic post—an expulsion that was front-page news across Great Britain and the United States—and Bonn’s salary at the LSE was to be paid for by donations.

Bonn was a student of empire. His first research, in the 1890s, had been on Ireland, where he went, as he later recalled, to “study backward economic life in the one western country where it had been preserved.”

Before the First World War he traveled to Southern Africa and became a prominent voice for colonial reform on his return to Germany, speaking alongside Colonial Secretary Bernhard Dernburg, not against empire, but for a different kind of empire, against

(miscegenation) and the ungovernable populations he felt it produced, and for a small all-white civil service that would protect the interest of the natives and guide them into the modern world of free labor and enterprise.
British Basutoland was the positive example he set against German Southwest Africa.

zh: 1933年，博恩向着挤满听众的讲堂演说一个在他看来深可忧虑、终究又势不可挡的现象，并且用了一个日后完全有资格声称由他首创的词——“非殖民化”（decolonization）。
他观察到，大战充当了两大世界历史进程的产婆：其一是帝国的终结，其二是计划。他认为“现代计划”诞生于战争年代——彼时“商品稀缺、人手短缺，人们试图以中央国家对生产与消费的控制，取代消费者主权”。计划是一种世俗的信仰，而非社会主义的信仰。“孕育它的是总体战和《国土防卫法》，而不是马克思和恩格斯。”
与许多近来的历史学家一样，博恩主张，战时计划永久性地拓展了政府可能性的地平线，催生出学者所谓的一种“可行性的妄想”（Machbarkeitswahn）——一种令人陶醉、甚而近于妄念的“无事不可为”之感。
en: Bonn spoke to the packed lecture hall in 1933 about what to him was a deeply concerning but ultimately inevitable phenomenon with a term that he would later have a good claim to have coined—“decolonization.”

He observed that the Great War had played midwife to two world historical processes. The first was the end of empire, the second was planning. He saw “modern planning” born in the war, when “scarcity of commodities and shortage of man power led to an attempt at substituting central state control over production and consumption for consumers’ sovereignty.” Planning was a secular, not a socialist, faith. “Total War and the Defense of the Realm Act, not Marx and Engels, were [its] parents.”
In common with many recent historians, Bonn argued that war planning had permanently extended the horizon of possibility for governments, and produced what one scholar has called a
or an intoxicating, and even delusional, sense of “doability.”

zh: 1918年之后，战时权宜变成了平时期待。国家在经济事务中的引导之手，在资本主义国家与社会主义国家都成了新常态。形形色色的法团主义增生蔓延。
在美国，博恩演讲前几个月，田纳西河流域管理局与《国家复兴法》（National Recovery Act）相继启动；苏联的第一个看似获得成功的五年计划也刚刚完成。新生国家降生在一个国家协调企业、并以此事为自然而然的气氛里。他说：“战时有时强加于并不情愿的各国政府的幼稚产业保护，如今已成为许多落后国家和所有新组建民族国家的经济目标。人们在一个早已过度工业化的世界里，仍然热切地追逐工业化。”
en: Wartime expediency became peacetime expectation after 1918. The guiding hand of the state in economic affairs became the new normal in both capitalist and socialist states. Varieties of corporatism pro-liferated.

In the United States, the Tennessee Valley Authority and the National Recovery Act had been launched months before Bonn’s speech, and the first apparently successful Five-Year Plan had just been completed in the Soviet Union. New nations were being born into an atmosphere where states coordinated enterprise and took this fact as natural. “The protection of infant industries,” he said, “forced upon sometimes unwilling governments during the war, has become the economic goal of many backward and all newly organized national states. Industrialization in an already over-industrialized world is fervently followed up.”

zh: 在博恩看来，非殖民化是“一场反对政治依附的运动”，其轴心是从帝国形态转向民族国家形态。但意义更为重大的是，它同时“转向反对经济依附”，从他所称的“国际经济相互依存”轴向闭关自足转去。
博恩对政治领域与经济领域的区分至关重要。各国可以有正式的主权，在经济上却依旧深深连缀其中。他甚至指出，各国未始不可以经济自主权缩水为代价换来正式的政治自治。他举希腊和中国为例：两国以平等身份被接纳进国联，条件是“对其财政继续维持某种控制”；对奥地利与匈牙利的财政监督也循同一路数。
换言之，各民族国家作为独立单位享有的政治平等，可以同他所称的那个覆盖全球的贸易与交换的“隐形经济帝国”并行不悖。
一个有边界的政治世界，能够（在自由主义的想象中，纵非现实中）与一个无边界的开放经济共存，而且此前确已如此共存。
en: Decolonization for Bonn was “a movement against political dependence” that pivoted from the empire form to the nation form. But more significantly, it also “turned against economic dependence,” pivoting from what he called “international economic interdependence” toward autarky.

Bonn’s distinction between the political and economic realms was central. Nations could have formal sovereignty while still remaining deeply connected economically. In fact, nations could even receive formal political autonomy on the condition of diminished economic autonomy. He cited the examples of Greece and China, which had been admitted as equals into the League of Nations but only with the “continuation of some sort of control over [their] finances,” and the financial oversight of Austria and Hungary, which followed the same pattern.
Atomistic national political equality, in other words, could coexist within what Bonn called the “invisible economic empire” of trade and exchange that was global.
A political world of borders could coexist, and had coexisted (in the liberal imagination, if not reality) within a borderless world economy.

zh: 博恩认为，非殖民化与计划是一枚硬币的两面，出自对相互依存世界中行得通的规模与形态的共同误解。然而，对“一个世界经济、多个政治体”这一模式而言，最终的叛逆者并非来自边陲，而是来自中心。隐形经济帝国得以成立的核心条件，本是币值的可预期性，以及由它生发的对契约、汇票与贷款的信任。这份信念在1931年9月20日一日之间化为乌有——英国那天放弃了金本位。博恩写道，经此一着，英国“打破了世界的经济统一”，并加速了全球政治体愈趋细碎化的进程：每一个政治体都配上自己必然低效的工业体系，又被一种错误的信念所误导——即约翰·梅纳德·凯恩斯（John Maynard Keynes）1933年所倡导的：民族自给自足是一个值得称道的目标。
“在9月21日之前，”博恩写道，“作为英国伟大传统的经济普世主义，与英国的经济民族主义尚是合流为一的。那一天，它们分道扬镳了。”
en: Bonn believed that decolonization and planning were two sides of a linked misunderstanding of the scale and form of what worked in an interdependent world. Yet the ultimate traitor to the model of one-world-economy-many-polities came not from the periphery but from the core. The central enabling condition of the invisible economic empire had been the predictability of currency value and the trust in the contract, the bill of exchange, and the loan that it created. This faith had vanished in a single day on September 20, 1931, when Britain left the gold standard. With that move, Bonn wrote, Great Britain “had broken the economic unity of the world” and accelerated the movement toward a globe of increasingly granular polities, each outfitted with its own necessarily inefficient industrial plant, misguided by the belief, promoted by John Maynard Keynes in 1933, that national self-sufficiency was a laudable goal.
“Up to the 21st September,” Bonn wrote, “economic universalism, as a great British tradition, coincided with British economic nationalism. On that day they parted company.”

zh: 1933年那天博恩在伦敦演说的想象，与新自由主义者是相通的——包括他在LSE的同事罗宾斯和哈耶克，以及勒普克。勒普克称赞博恩，他1942年的著作取名《国际经济解体》（
），部分灵感很可能就来自博恩1938年专著《帝国的崩解：世界经济的解体》（
Disintegration of World Economy）的副题。

与博恩一样，新自由主义者对帝国持一种区别看待的态度。他们看到一道鸿沟：一边是众多糟糕的帝国——保护殖民地贸易、把世界经济视为储量有限的零和容器；另一边是唯一的良善帝国——英国，它倡导自由贸易与健全货币。他们把大英帝国看作1870—1914年第一次全球化时代的北极星。他们相信，1931年以来，英国在有组织劳工的阶级压力与凯恩斯主义的思想魅惑之下背弃了经济普世主义；这一信念促使他们苦苦思索：在伦敦金融城间接统治的自由贸易帝国之后，什么能成为世界新的组织原则，什么又能成为承担组织的权力？那个在他们看来如此用心维系统治权（imperium）与所有权（dominium）之分的帝国消失之后，该怎么办？
en: The imagination from which Bonn spoke on that day in London in 1933 was shared by the neoliberals, including his colleagues Robbins and Hayek at the LSE and Röpke, who praised Bonn and likely was inspired to title his 1942 book
partially by the subtitle of Bonn’s 1938 monograph

Like Bonn, the neoliberals had a differentiated attitude toward empire. They saw a chasm between, on the one hand, the many bad empires that protected their colonial trade and saw the world economy as a zero-sum container of finite resources, and, on the other hand, the single good empire of the British that promoted free trade and sound money. They saw the British Empire as the polestar of the first age of globalization from 1870 to 1914. The belief that the British had betrayed economic universalism since 1931 under the class pressures of organized labor and the intellectual seductions of Keynesianism led them to think hard about what a new organizing principle and an organizing force could be in a world after free-trade empire under the indirect rule of the City of London. What to do after the disappearance of the empire that had been so mindful, in their opinion, of the separation between imperium and dominium?

zh: 新自由主义者得出的解方是超国家联邦。他们承认政治边界无法取消，承认民族主义是一种对人们有着无法消除的感召力的力量，于是寻找博恩所说的对边界的“去毒化”。他写道：“倘若边界不再是国际经济交往的障碍，它们就会失去一部分凶险的意义。”
其设想是重建交换与贸易的隐形经济帝国，其上再覆盖一张由外部边界围合、名为民族国家的政治单元网格。他们在1930年代的激进主张归结为一问——倘若帝国终结了，而那无甚要紧，又如何？
en: The solution that the neoliberals arrived at was supranational federation. Accepting that political frontiers could not be eliminated, and that nationalism was a force that spoke to people in an ineradicable way, they sought what Bonn called the “sterilization of frontiers.” “If frontiers were no longer obstacles to international economic inter-course,” he wrote, “they would lose part of their sinister significance.”

The idea was to reconstitute the invisible economic empire of exchange and trade overlaid with a grid of externally bounded political units called nations. Their radical proposition in the 1930s was to ask—what if empire ended, and it didn’t matter?

zh: 罗宾斯与“去计划化”的理念

children: ROBBINS AND THE IDEA OF DEPLANNING

zh: 1935年，博恩演讲一年半之后，莱昂内尔·罗宾斯自驾汽车赴瑞士，就国际经济计划问题发表系列演讲。抵达后他住在米塞斯家中，此前却驾车穿过了纳粹统治下的德国，在那些在他看来“笑容可掬、你以为任何政治风暴的涟漪都传不进去”的巴伐利亚村庄里看到了横幅上的反犹标语。
邀他讲演的是拉帕德。此人在1930年代把自己的高等国际问题研究院办成了一个新自由主义的智库：1935年请来米塞斯，1937年请来勒普克，又有哈伯勒、哈耶克与雅各布·维纳（Jacob Viner）来院研究与讲学。罗宾斯的日内瓦讲稿于1937年以《经济计划与国际秩序》（
）为题出版，《经济学人》（Economist）杂志称之为“宣言”。
讲演直面他所称的“我们这个时代的万灵膏丹”——计划——一个虚假的神祇，在他看来，纳粹主义等等种种祸事都要归咎于它，而他刚刚亲眼目睹了纳粹主义。这部作品还提供了新自由主义联邦模式的第一稿，哈耶克日后正是在其上搭建自家的构想。
en: In 1935, a year and a half after Bonn’s lecture, Lionel Robbins traveled to Switzerland by car to deliver a series of lectures on the topic of international economic planning. He stayed with Mises when he got there but drove through Nazi-governed Germany, seeing anti-Semitic slogans on banners in what he called “smiling Bavarian villages where you would have thought not a ripple of these political convulsions would have penetrated.”

He had been invited to give the lectures by Rappard, who had turned his Graduate Institute of International Studies into a kind of neoliberal think tank in the 1930s, bringing Mises in 1935, Röpke in 1937, and Haberler, Hayek and Jacob Viner for stays of research and teaching. Published under the title
in 1937, Robbins’s Geneva talks were declared a “manifesto” by the

They took on what he called “the grand panacea of our age”—planning—a false god that he saw as responsible for among other things, the Nazism he had just seen firsthand. It also offered the first draft of a model of neoliberal federation upon which Hayek would build his own ideas.

zh: 与博恩一样，罗宾斯把非殖民化与计划看作形式上同构、结构上相互加持。帝国的瓦解正引致统治与所有权两重范畴的混淆：“‘矿场归矿工’与‘巴布亚归巴布亚人’，是两个在分析上同构的口号。”
在李普曼座谈会上，米塞斯也曾说过类似的话：“物主代词的含混使用常常妨碍理解。一位并非矿主的英国公民，凭什么把英国煤矿称作‘我们的’，把鲁尔区的煤矿称作‘外邦人的’？作为煤炭买主，无论英国煤还是外国煤，他都得照市场价付款。”

罗宾斯寻求一种人类社会组织的形态，把政治与经济领域的界线厘清，将矿工或巴布亚人这类小而离散、彼此认同的集体消融于一个更大的统一体之中。与博恩一样，他认为英国直到1931年都提供了这样一个跨国框架。他写道，“门户开放政策”意味着“帝国境内由本土治理的那些部分，其治理方式仿佛受托为整个世界管理这些领地”。“只要外国货物自由准入，外国投资和外国人移居不受歧视，英国人并不因其国家拥有广袤属地而在经济上比外国人得利更多……。自由贸易帝国的治理，”他说，“并非那种需要英国人引为羞耻的历史插曲之一。”
en: Like Bonn, Robbins read decolonization and planning as both formally homologous and structurally reinforcing. The dissolution of empires was leading to a confusion of the categories of government and ownership: “ ‘the mines for the miners’ and ‘Papua for the Papuans’ are analytically similar slogans,” he said.

At the Lippmann Colloquium, Mises had commented similarly that “the ambiguous use of possessive pronouns frequently impedes understanding. On what grounds does a British citizen who is not a mine owner describe British coal deposits as ‘ours’ and those of the Ruhr as those of ‘foreigners’? As a purchaser of coal, he is obliged in each case to pay the market price, whether it is British or foreign coal.”

Robbins sought a form of human social organization that would clarify the distinction between the political and economic realms and dissolve the small, discrete collective of mutual identification—the miners or the Papuans—in a larger unity. Like Bonn, he saw the British as having provided such a transnational frame until 1931. The “open door policy” meant “that those parts of the Empire which were administered from at home were administered as if in trust for the world as a whole,” he wrote. “So long as foreign goods were admitted free and foreign investment and foreign settlement not discriminated against, the Englishman was not economically better off than the foreigner because his country had wide possessions … The administration of the free-trade Empire is not,” he said, “one of those episodes of history of which Englishmen need be ashamed.”

zh: 在罗宾斯与博恩看来，世界经济提供一个普世主义的空间——一个属于全人类的共同活动舞台，由大英帝国的保护性统治司掌其成。当务之急是找到一种政治形式，填补英国放弃这一角色所留下的真空——1932年《渥太华协定》（Ottawa Agreements）让英国优先进入其殖民地与英联邦的市场之后，这一真空尤为刺眼。拉帕德在1933年国际研究会议上谴责了该协定。他说，帝国统治最好的正当理由是“原始居民按其自身利益……同时也按全世界利益加以治理”。门户开放式帝国“既保障土著在与世界其余部分交往中的平等，又为世界其他地区提供工业品销路，并让它们可以自由获得货源”。
如果说英国1931年退出金本位是对自由秩序的第一次破毁，那么次年它把殖民边界改作经济高墙，便是第二次。
en: For Robbins and Bonn, the world economy provided a space of universalism, a shared arena of activity for all humanity overseen by the protective rule of the British Empire. What was necessary was a political form to fill the vacuum created by the British abdication of the role, especially after the Ottawa Agreements of 1932, which created preferential access for Great Britain to its colonies and commonwealth. Rappard condemned the agreements at the International Studies Conference in 1933. The best justification for imperial rule, he said, was “that the primitive population shall be governed in their own interests … and also in the interest of the whole world.” The Open Door empire had “assured the natives of equality in their relations with the rest of the world, and assured the world of outlets for its industrial products and free sources of supply.”
If the British had broken the liberal order once by leaving the gold standard in 1931, they had done so again the following year by turning colonial borders into economic walls.

zh: 新自由主义的联邦诸方案，出自一场范围极广、如今大半已被遗忘的讨论：究竟该用何种政治形式去改良、重振或取代帝国形态。美国记者克拉伦斯·斯特赖特1939年出版《现在就联合》（
），使跨大西洋的联邦讨论有了焦点；但认真而论，这场讨论于1932年便在《新联邦季刊》（
）的版面上以及大致同期圆桌集团（Round Table Group）的出版物中发端。
在最常见的几种变体里，联邦与联盟被设想为大西洋的、盎格鲁-撒克逊的或西欧的架构，用以把奉行孤立主义的美国拉回西方共同体，并充作法西斯主义与共产主义两股势力的屏障。
en: Neoliberal proposals of federation came out of incredibly wide-ranging, and now largely forgotten, discussions about which political form might be used to reform, reinvigorate or replace that of empire. Transatlantic discussions of federation were given focus by the publication of American journalist Clarence Streit’s
in 1939 but had begun in earnest in the pages of
in 1932 and the publications of the Round Table Group at around the same time.

In their most common variations, federation and union were proposed as Atlantic, Anglo-Saxon or Western European configurations that could bring an isolationist U.S. back into the community of the West and act as a bulwark against forces of both fascism and communism.

zh: 就大多数人而言，联邦的着眼点是道德的、种族的、文明的或政治的。罗宾斯的着眼点则是经济的。他说：“自由主义世界联邦的目标，将是给国际分工开创最大的余地：任何对政府管辖区域之间贸易的限制，都与它的主旨全然不容。”
民族国家的首要角色是安全，并确保“世界各地的财产法与契约法得到统一，并按整齐划一的原则加以实施”。
一旦自由贸易、私人产权的世界秩序确立起来，帝国就无足轻重了。因为“对地球表面任何可以想象的再划分，都不可能有持久的满意可言”，唯一长治久安的办法，是让世界的资源向所有人开放。
他以19世纪为例：“英国工业最重要的原料……原棉——是在帝国之外购买的。无论棉花购自卡罗来纳还是苏丹，都得付钱。只要契约在两地都能强制执行，它们在地图上是否涂成同色就无关宏旨。”
en: The focus of federation for most was moral, racial, civilizational or political. For Robbins, it was economic. “It would be the object of a liberal world federation,” he said, “to create the maximum scope for international division of labor: and any restriction of trading between governmental areas would be totally alien to its intention.”
The primary role of nation-states would be security and ensuring that “the law of property and contract the world over was unified and administered on uniform principles.”

If the free-trade-private-property world order were put into place, then empire would be insignificant. Because “there is no conceivable repartition of the earth’s surface which would be permanently satisfactory,” the only lasting solution would be to make the world’s resources accessible to all.

He uses the example of the nineteenth century when “the most important raw material of British industry … raw cotton—was purchased outside the Empire. Whether cotton is purchased in Carolina or the Sudan, it has to be paid for. Provided that contracts are enforceable in both places, it is a matter of indifference whether or not they are colored the same on the map.”

zh: 世界联邦模式的高明之处在于：单凭自身之力，它就会启动一种罗宾斯所称的“去计划化”动态。
计划者在国际贸易中掌握的最重要的工具——关税——将沦为禁忌，也就意味着幼稚产业或国内农业的保护就此告终。更具深意的是，它还将意味着拆解社会福利事业。正如他所言：“国家计划不仅涉及在贸易与投资流动上搁置自由放任（
），还涉及在人员流动上搁置自由放行（
他观察道，国家发放福利，意味着限制自由流动，以保住对受益者的控制。这正是平等承诺本身具有腐蚀性的原因之一。“我们必须承认，”他说，“这套制度将带来某种程度的收入不平等。”
在民族国家的尺度上制造经济均平，只会催生对繁荣来源的错觉。个人福祉取决于世界经济中不断变化的流动，各国国民必须始终能够切身体会这一点。计划湮没了令人振奋的全球之声。正如他1934年所言，商人随时可能“关掉兰开夏的工厂，转赴日本开工”——这个可能性必须常存。
共担的不安定处境，能够也应当成为世界统一的基础。
en: The genius of the world federation model was that, by its own power, it would begin a dynamic of what Robbins called “deplanning.”

The most important tool of the planner in international trade—the tariff—would be taboo, meaning an end to the protection of infant industry or domestic agriculture. More meaningfully, it would also mean the dismantling of social services. As he said, “National planning involves not merely the suspension of
as regards movements of trade and investment. It involves also the suspension of
as regards the movements of men.”

The provision of benefits by the state, he observed, means the restriction of free movement to retain control over who benefited. This was one of the reasons that the promise of equality itself was corrosive. “We must recognize,” he said, that “the system would involve some inequality of income.”

Creating economic evenness at the scale of the nation only produced a misguided sense of the origin of prosperity. The contingency of individual well-being on the flows of world economy must remain a palpable reality for national citizens. Planning muffled the bracing sounds of the global. It must always be a possibility that, as he put it in 1934, the merchant might “close down his works in Lancashire to commence operations in Japan.”
Shared precarity could and should be the foundation of world unity.

zh: 哈耶克的新自由主义联邦
与罗宾斯一样，哈耶克也是“联邦同盟”（Federal Union）的成员。这个呼吁建立联邦的组织成立于1938年，到1940年已有逾一万两千名会员；哈耶克与罗宾斯还同任联邦同盟的经济学家委员会委员。
受挚友兼同事的启发，哈耶克在《新联邦季刊》1939年的一篇文章中，把自由贸易世界联邦的想象发挥得最为完备，描述了一种能够瓦解“利益连带”的政治模式——当一群人拥有相同的经济利益时，这种连带便会自然而然地凝聚成形。
非殖民化未始不能运行良好：就它能把政治与经济脱钩而言。政治主权与经济主权两相重合，才造成哈耶克眼中那种扰人心神的“所有感”——国民对于本国领土产品的所有权之感。“在民族国家里，流行意识形态使得说服共同体其余成员相信保护‘他们的’钢铁工业、‘他们的’小麦生产——不管是什么——符合他们自身的利益，变得相当容易。”
联邦的目标，就是斩断政治公民身份与经济所有权之间的链接。
en: Like Robbins, Hayek was a member of Federal Union, an organization calling for federation founded in 1938 that had over 12,000 members by 1940; he and Robbins were also members of the economists’ committee of the Federal Union.
Inspired by the work of his close friend and colleague, Hayek elaborated the free-trade world federation imaginary in its most complete form in a 1939 article in New Commonwealth Quar
where he described a political model that would undermine the “solidarity of interests” that naturally cohered when groups of people had the same economic interests.

Decolonization might actually work well in the sense that it would delink the political and the economic. It was the correspondence of political and economic sovereignty that produced what Hayek saw as the troubling sense of ownership that citizens of a nation felt over the products of their national territory. “In the national state, current ideologies make it comparatively easy to persuade the rest of the community that it is in their interest to protect ‘their’ iron industry or ‘their’ wheat production of whatever it be.”
The goal of federation was to break the link between political citizenship and economic ownership.

zh: 经济边界一旦开放，利益格局就将永无定势，也决不会“与特定地域的居民长久绑定”。与罗宾斯一样，哈耶克描述了货物与投资的自由流动如何把经济从干预与计划中驯导出来。资本将流动起来寻求更高的利息回报，货物将从价格更低之地而来，“因此，销售局以及单个行业其他种种垄断组织构成的整副兵器谱，都将不再为各国政府所驱策”。
世界政府将不得不专注于为市场建立围封框架这一职分，而非按照平等或社会正义的逻辑配置资源。这个松散的联邦管得窄，却管得深，务使经济流动本身所施加的约束决定资源的配置。社会立法将由一种监管层面上的最惠国逻辑统摄：落入计划或管制之域的社会生活面向将日渐其少。“我们不得不安于宁可某个特定领域没有立法，也不要那种会瓦解联邦经济统一性的国家立法。”
en: Open economic borders would mean that constellations of interests would never be permanent nor would they become “lastingly identified with the inhabitants of a particular region.” Like Robbins, Hayek described how the free flow of goods and investment would discipline economies away from intervention and planning. Because capital will move to find better interest rates and goods will come from places with lower prices, “the whole armory of marketing boards and other forms of monopolistic organizations of individual industries will cease to be at the disposal of state governments.”

World government would by necessity focus on the task of encasing the market rather than allocating resources according to a logic of equality or social justice. The loose federation would govern narrowly but intensively, ensuring that the disciplining effect of economic flows determined the allocation of resources. Social legislation would be governed by a kind of regulatory most-favored-nation logic, whereby fewer and fewer aspects of social life would fall under planning or regulation. “We shall have to resign ourselves rather to have no legislation in a particular field than the state legislation which would break up the economic unity of the federation.”

zh: 经政治联邦守护的开放世界经济，可以充作计划的解药，并对非殖民化给出自己的答案。哈耶克与罗宾斯一致认为：要人们为了与自己地隔万里的他者承受关税或再分配政策，是不可能的。哈耶克发问：“法国农民肯为帮助英国化学工业而多付肥料钱吗？瑞典工人肯为成全加利福尼亚果农而多付橘子钱吗？……南非矿工肯为接济挪威渔民而多付沙丁鱼钱吗？”
罗宾斯说得更直白：“譬如，假设斯堪的纳维亚居民的劳务有一部分用于贡献资源、提高中国居民的生产率，那就像收入均平化的情形一样，意味着他们拿到的少于本可拿到的，为的是别人多拿到。”
亚当·斯密曾把西方人可以免除多少自身的痛苦与一位中国官吏的死放在一起设问。两人倒过来问：西方人肯为让一位中国官吏受益而付出多少努力？他们的结论是，付出会很少。
en: The open world economy protected by political federation could be the antidote to planning and the solution to decolonization. Hayek and Robbins agreed that people would not accept either tariffs or redistributive policies for the sake of people geographically distant from them. Hayek asked: “Is it likely that the French peasant will be willing to pay more for his fertilizer to help the British chemical industry? Will the Swedish workman be ready to pay more for his oranges to assist the Californian grower? … Or the South African miner prepared to pay more for his sardines to help the Norwegian fisherman?”

Robbins observed, even more pointedly: “If, for instance, the services of the inhabitants of say Scandinavia are in part devoted to providing resources to raise the productivity of the inhabitants of China, that means, as in the case of income equalization, that they get less than they might have had in order that others may get more.”

Reversing Adam Smith’s hypothetical question about how much Western pain would be averted for the death of a Mandarin, they asked how much Western effort would be expended for the benefit of a Mandarin and concluded the answer would be: very little.

zh: 罗宾斯写道：“国际自由主义并未要我们博爱人类……它不过是一部比列国世界更高效的机器的设计图。”
反计划可以自居反帝国主义，因为它把帝国斥为无关宏旨，代之以一个由商业与资本之流维系的松散联邦。世界联邦把非殖民化置于从属地位，从而化解了非殖民化难题——帝国的解散，从属于一个更大的愿景：重建英国人1931年后弃之不顾的自由主义国际经济秩序。就历史学家弗雷德里克·库珀（Frederick Cooper）所描述的“非殖民化的辩证法”
而言，新自由主义联邦提供了另一种了局。库珀看到的是，在1945年之后的世界里，“社会公民资格”（social citizenship）开始意味着更多东西，西非殖民地中地位日益提升的劳工群体提出种种要求，加速了帝国的终结；罗宾斯与哈耶克则预想再拧紧一道螺丝：国内的计划措施，将被一套安排所溶蚀——在这套安排里，资本与货物的自由流动削弱了维系计划措施的“利益共同体”。
1930年代，社会民主国家还只在母腹之中。新自由主义者此时已在谋划对付它的方案，令人讶异。在他们版本的联邦里，世界经济的规训之力将瓦解计划，并把民族国家的活动限制在政治领域。
en: Robbins wrote, “International liberalism does not bid us love humanity … it is merely the plan of a mechanism more efficient than the world of independent nations.”

Anti-planning could present itself as anti-imperialist by casting empire as irrelevant, proposing instead a loose federation united by the flows of commerce and capital. World federation solved the problem of decolonization by decentering it, making the dissolution of empire secondary to a larger vision of restoring a liberal international economic order abandoned by the British after 1931. Neoliberal federation offered an alternative outcome to the “dialectics of decolonization” described by historian Frederick Cooper.

Where Cooper saw the demands of an increasingly empowered colonial labor force in West Africa hastening the end of empire in a post-1945 world where “social citizenship” had begun to mean more, Robbins and Hayek envisioned a further turn of the screw, in which planning measures at home were dissolved by an arrangement in which the free flow of capital and goods undercut the “communities of interest” that sustained them.

The social democratic state was only in utero in the 1930s. It is striking to see neoliberals already devising a scheme to counter it. In their version of federation, the discipline of the world economy would undermine planning and confine the nation-state to the field of the political.

zh: 米塞斯与“双重政府”的哈布斯堡渊源

children: MISES AND THE HABSBURG ORIGINS OF DOUBLE GOVERNMENT

zh: 无须深挖哈耶克1939年那篇短文，也能望见他的世界秩序愿景。他把1944年的畅销书《通往奴役之路》（
）最后一章整章用来重申自己的国际联邦方案。他明言：世界经济唯有以政治手段方能捍卫。“事情绝非如当今广为相信的那样，”他写道，“似乎我们需要一个国际经济权威，而各国同时又能保持其不受限制的政治主权——真相几乎恰恰相反。我们需要并有望做到的，不是把更多权力交进不负责任的国际经济权威之手，而是相反，建立一种能约束各方经济利益的更高层级政治权力。”
哈耶克主张，唯有这样一个“强有力的”“超国家权威”，才能阻止单个国家的职权以损害整体繁荣的方式扩张。这个反计划的世界权威，将充作其他自由论者所称“去民族主义”（denationalism）的执行人：监察国际联邦的成员国，强制执行自由贸易与自由投资的准则。
联邦是实现战斗性全球主义（militant globalism）与战斗性民主（militant democracy）的目标的手段：“它无非是把民主——人类迄今发明的唯一和平变革之法——推广于国际事务，”他写道，“但这是一个权力受到明确限制的民主。”
en: One does not have to excavate Hayek’s short 1939 article to descry his vision of world order. He devoted the whole final chapter of his 1944 best seller

to a reprisal of his schemes for international federation. He made it explicit that the world economy could be defended only by political means. “Far from it being true,” he wrote, “that, as is now widely believed, we need an international economic authority while the states can at the same time retain their unrestricted political sovereignty, almost exactly the opposite is true. What we need and can hope to achieve is not more power in the hands of irresponsible international economic authorities, but, on the contrary, a superior political power which can hold the economic interests in check.”

Hayek argued that only such a “powerful” “supranational authority” could prevent the mandate of individual states from expanding in ways that would damage the prosperity of the whole. The anti-planning world authority would be an agent of what other liberals called “denationalism,” overseeing the member states of an international federation and enforcing standards of free trade and free investment.

Federation was a means of achieving the goals of militant globalism and militant democracy: it is “nothing but the application to international affairs of democracy, the only method of peaceful change man has yet invented,” he wrote, “but it is a democracy with definitely limited powers.”

zh: 哈耶克关于全球治理的诸方案长期无人置理，直到学者们近来才在他的联邦制构想中重新发现“自由主义国际主义的再造”，以及欧洲经济一体化若有似无——甚至昭然若揭——的思想源头。
沃尔夫冈·斯特雷克（Wolfgang Streeck）写道，哈耶克的著作设计了一系列把“国际化”与“去民族化”同势不可挡的自由化捆绑在一起的制度，“读来就像今日欧盟的施工蓝图”。
第6章将掂量哈耶克对欧洲一体化之影响的说法，第7章则讨论他对世界贸易组织（世贸组织）设计者的影响。
en: Hayek’s proposals for global governance had been largely passed over until scholars recently rediscovered, in his proposals for federalism, the “reinvention of liberal internationalism” and the implicit—and even explicit—inspiration for European economic integration.

Wolfgang Streeck writes that Hayek’s work “reads like a blueprint for today’s European Union” in its design for institutions that link “internationalization” and “denationalization” with inexorable liberalization.
Chapter 6 weighs the claim of Hayekian inspiration for European integration, and Chapter 7 his influence on architects of the World Trade Organization.

zh: 然而值得注意的是：即便有学者追踪了哈耶克的国际主义如何影响后世，也没有把它往回追溯——追溯到他青年时代身处的哈布斯堡帝国。1978年哈耶克回忆道：“我想我有生以来写的第一篇东西……是还在军中的最后几天里已涌上心头的念头：不妨来一个双重政府——一个文化政府和一个经济政府。”他说，这是他思考“奥匈帝国各民族之间的冲突”的解法时想到的一个办法。他琢磨：“政府职能也许可以一分为二——让各民族自办其文化事业，同时让中央政府提供一个共同经济体系的框架。”
依哈耶克所说，这“头一个落在纸上的念头”提示着哈布斯堡帝国对新自由主义国际秩序与联邦方案的影响——这一影响长期被忽视。
en: What is notable, however, is that even those scholars who trace Hayek’s internationalism forward fail to trace it backward: to the Habsburg Empire of his youth. Reflecting in 1978, Hayek wrote, “I think the first paper I ever wrote … was on a thing which had already occurred to me in the last few days in the army, suggesting that you might have a double government, a cultural and an economic government.” He said that this occurred to him as one way to resolve “the conflict between nationalities in the Austro-Hungarian Empire.” He wondered if “it might be possible in governmental functions to separate the two things—let the nationalities have their own cultural arrangements and yet let the central government provide the framework of a common economic system.”
This idea, “the first thing I put on paper,” according to Hayek, suggests the overlooked influence of the Habsburg Empire on neoliberal proposals of international order and federation.

zh: 新自由主义核心思想家的根系扎在前哈布斯堡帝国，此事绝非偶然。正如约翰·格雷（John Gray）所言，哈耶克眼中，烟消云散的哈布斯堡帝国“在某些方面堪称一个样板式的自由政体”。
对许多在维也纳长大的知识分子来说，哈布斯堡帝国是一件失落的认同对象。哲学家卡尔·波普尔（Karl Popper）是哈耶克的友人之一，他在追念中把帝国理想化，视之为一个“为人类进步辛勤劳作的世界性科学共同体”的空间。
还在帝国存续之时，许多人就已钟情地把帝国看作“缩微的人类国际秩序”。
在新自由主义者看来，帝国的世界主义示范并预演了一个未来的世界。事后观之，哈布斯堡帝国最摄人心魄之处，在于经济与政治的分立。多民族原则使帝国成为单一的经济空间，却没有单一同质的语言或文化。“国家与民族并不重合”——哈布斯堡王朝的这一事实令米塞斯着迷。不像法兰西诸共和国，也不像1848年之后德国、意大利、波兰的种种想象，哈布斯堡奥地利不曾把“民族原则”奠为自己的“意识形态基础”。
一个多民族国家意味着：任何干预之举都可能因显得迎合特殊利益，而危及纵横交错的政治均势。
en: The fact that the core neoliberal thinkers had roots in the former Habsburg Empire was far from incidental. As John Gray remarks, Hayek saw the vanished Habsburg Empire as “in some ways a model liberal regime.”

The Habsburg Empire was a lost object of identification for many Viennese-raised intellectuals. The philosopher Karl Popper, who was one of Hayek’s friends, idealized the empire in retrospect, seeing it as the space of a “cosmopolitan scientific community laboring for human progress.”
Even during its existence, many thought fondly of the empire as representing “the international order of mankind in miniature.”

For neoliberals, the empire’s cosmopolitanism modeled and prefigured a future world. Among the most compelling aspects of the Habsburg Empire in retrospect was its separation of economics and politics. The multinational principle had made the empire a single economic space without a homogeneous language or culture. Mises was fascinated by the fact that “state and nation did not coincide” in the Habsburg monarchy. Unlike the French republics, or the post-1848 imaginaries of Germany, Italy, or Poland, Habsburg Austria did not have “the nationality principle” at its “ideological foundation.”
A multinational state meant that every effort at intervention would threaten to upset the diplomatic balance by appearing to cater to special interests.

zh: 现实中特殊利益无时无刻不在得其所哉，米塞斯却死守这样一幅国家理念：它在自我理解上已然去民族化，因而对以民族名义提出的诉求密不透风。对米塞斯与哈耶克而言，哈布斯堡帝国里政治单元与经济单元的不一，为全世界提供了一个样板。奥地利新自由主义者关于1945年后一个非殖民化地球的愿景，将建立在他们自身对本土非殖民化的经历与观察之上。耐人寻味的是，消逝的哈布斯堡帝国竟成了帝国之后世界经济的模范。
en: Though such special interests were served all the time in reality, Mises clung to the idea of a state that was denationalized in its own self-conception and thus impermeable to demands made in the language of the nation. For Mises and Hayek, the nonidentity of political and economic units in the Habsburg Empire offered a model for the world. The Austrian neoliberal vision of a decolonizing globe after 1945 would be based on their own experience and observation of decolonization at home. The vanished Habsburg Empire, ironically, became a model for the world economy after empire.

zh: 米塞斯的国际联邦方案比哈耶克的更贴近哈布斯堡样板。的确，他关于超国家联邦最明确的设想，紧贴着旧帝国的疆界勾勒，而且他对更大规模的“民主世界政府”或跨大陆的联邦明确表示怀疑。
要理解他的想象，须先略述支撑其学术的那幅政治与经济地理。自最早的著作起，米塞斯就一直运作于一组二元对立：一侧是以“民族原则”与民族自决组织起来的世界，另一侧是以国际分工组织起来、对民族身份不着一问、覆盖“地球全部有人居住的表面”的世界。
把世界编组成民族国家，与经济原则相抵牾，因为它对人口与其他生产要素的安排未达最优。理想而言，经济规律终将随时间推移压倒政治规律。“地球表面被列国分占。这一划分是既往历史过程的结果，并不符合现行的生产与人口条件。若人员与货物完全自由流动，有些国家的土地将会更加人烟稠密，有些则更加稀疏。这种相对过剩人口，必须借迁移之流当下化解。”
在米塞斯那个抽干了政治的经济规范性愿景里，人口随岁月消长；而有些民族可能消失，或在同化过程中被其他群体吸收。
en: Mises’s proposals for international federation followed the Habsburg example more closely than Hayek’s. Indeed, Mises’s most explicit proposals for supranational federation hewed closely to the borders of the former empire, and he expressed skepticism about a larger-scale “democratic world government” or a federation that would span continents.

Gaining an understanding of his imagination requires a brief overview of the political and economic geography that underpinned Mises’s work. From his earliest publications, Mises operated with the binary opposition between a world organized by the “principle of nationality” and self-determination, and one organized by the international division of labor, indifferent to nationality, across “the entire inhabited surface of the earth.”

The organization of the world into nations con-tradicted economic principles because it arranged people and other factors of production in less than optimal ways. Ideally, economic laws would trump political laws over time. “The surface of the earth is divided among nations. This division is the result of past historical processes. It does not correspond to current conditions of production and population. Under full free movement of people and goods, there are nations whose areas would be more densely and others more thinly settled. This relative overpopulation must be dissolved now through movements of migration.”
In Mises’s normative vision of economics drained of politics, populations would grow and shrink with time; and nationalities would, in some cases, be lost or absorbed through assimilation.

zh: 鲜有人留意：米塞斯把战间期那场著名的社会主义计算论战，不是摆在民族国家、而是摆在全球的尺度上搬演。
他声称，一位假想的“世界经济总管理者”是多余的，因为“在理想的世界社会主义之下要听凭世界经济总管理者下令才能做到的事，在自由世界经济的理想境界里由竞争的统治自行达成”。
在市场体制中，企业、资本与劳工会自动流向收益更佳的条件；不流动便是失败，终究便是饿死。米塞斯有几分痛快地承认，他对世界的理解与卡尔·马克思在许多方面若合符节。他觉得马克思是其时代——1860年代——的产物，那时自由贸易雄踞西欧，对未来世界政府的谈论也显得顺理成章。毕竟，他指出，自由主义与马克思主义社会主义同样都是世界主义的。
而且，资产阶级如同无产阶级，本性上也是“国际性的”。
两人之别在于对结局的诊断。马克思看到的是日甚一日的贫困化；米塞斯看到的则是一条通往繁荣的大道，先是被1870年代应对第一次大萧条的关税战粗暴截断，继而遭大战的断裂与随后卷土重来的贸易障碍拦腰斩折。
en: It is not often noticed that Mises staged the famous socialist calculation debate of the interwar period not at the scale of the nation but at the scale of the world.

He claimed that a hypothetical “general director of the world economy” was redundant because “what would happen under ideal world socialism by order of the general director of the world economy is achieved in the ideal of the free world economy by the reign of competition.”

In a market system, companies, capital, and workers migrated of their own accord to better-yielding conditions. To fail to migrate would be to fail and, ultimately, to starve. Mises conceded somewhat cheerfully that his understanding of the world coincided in many ways with that of Karl Marx. He felt that Marx was a product of his time—the 1860s—when free trade reigned in Western Europe and talk of a coming world government seemed plausible. After all, he pointed out, liberalism and Marxist socialism were both cosmopolitan.
And the bourgeoisie, like the proletariat, was also inherently “international.”

Where they differed was in the diagnosis of the outcome. Where Marx saw increasing immiseration, Mises saw the road to prosperity rudely interrupted by the tariff wars of the 1870s in response to the first Great Depression, then the rupture of the Great War, and the return of trade obstacles that followed.

zh: 在米塞斯眼中，地球是一片禀赋各异、幅员辽阔的土地，亟待借资本、劳工与商业的流动尽可能彻底地加以开发。追逐生产率的冲动是不证自明的。他把以下这条称作资本主义的“基本社会法则”：“让尽可能多的人参与人与人之间的分工，把地球的全部表面卷入地理分工。”
他承认，在“竞争的统治”之下，个人腾挪转圜的余地少得可怜。
论及企业家，他写道：“市场对他的驾驭，比任何政府或社会其他机构都更严苛、更苛求。”
对工人亦然：“作为生产者……人不过是共同体的代理人，身为代理人便须服从。”
个人可相机行事的余地，只存在于消费者的身份之中。他说过——这个比喻他终生沿用——资本主义社会是“一种消费者的民主……其中每一便士都等于一张选票”。
en: Mises saw the earth as a vast territory of varying natural endowments that needed to be exploited as thoroughly as possible through the mobility of capital, labor, and commerce. The drive toward productivity was axiomatic. He called it the “fundamental social law” of capitalism “to draw the greatest number of human beings into the personal division of labor and the whole earth’s surface into the geographical division of labor.”
Life under “the reign of competition” left admittedly little room for individual maneuver.
Of the entrepreneur, he wrote, “The market controls him more strictly and exactingly than could any government or other organ of society.”
For workers it was similar: “As producer … a man is merely the agent of the community and as such has to obey.”

The space for discretionary action one had was as a consumer. Capitalist society, he said, in an analogy he would use throughout this life, was a “consumer’s democracy … in which every penny represents a ballot paper.”

zh: 米塞斯把国际分工看作一个至少理论上终有完成之日的过程。他说，它是“有限的。当地球上所有人组成一个统一的分工体系时，它便抵达了自己的目标”。
这一过程的最终结局，将是所谓“普世社会”（ecumenical society）的浮现，并且必然伴随一个世界超级国家：它通过同那条行不通的民族自决原则一刀两断，来兑现国际联盟未竟的承诺，进而担起自己在护卫贸易、投资与移民方面恰当的——有限却高强度——的角色。
对米塞斯来说，世界经济的要求压倒一切其他政治主张。譬如论及殖民主义，他曾说“历史上没有哪一页比殖民史浸透更多鲜血”，却仍坚持：欧洲既已依赖从殖民地获取原料，保住殖民地就是第一要务。
民族自决未始不可设想，但只能处在一个强健有力、足以确保自由贸易延续的超级国家的统摄之下。
en: Mises saw the international division of labor as a process that, at least hypothetically, might one day be completed. It was, he said, “finite. When all men on earth form a unitary system of division of labor, it will have reached its goal.”

The eventual outcome of this process would be the emergence of what he called “ecumenical society” and, necessarily, an accompanying world superstate that would realize the failed promise of the League of Nations by divorcing itself from the impracticable principle of national self-determination and taking up its proper limited—but intensive—role in safeguarding trade, investment, and migration.

For Mises, the demands of the world economy trumped all other political claims. In discussing colonialism, for example, he remarked that “no chapter of history is steeped further in blood than the history of colonialism” but still insisted that keeping the colonies was the first priority once Europe become dependent on the empire for raw materials.
Self-determination might be thinkable, but only under the control of a muscular superstate that could ensure the continuation of free trade.

zh: 对米塞斯而言，一切政策问题都要拿到世界经济的生产率这块试金石上去检验。同样，他之所以扬民主而抑独裁、取自由劳动而舍奴隶制，也纯属功能上的考虑。让人们投票，革命的次数就会减少；让人们领工资干活，他们比身为奴隶财产时更有产出。
竞争的统治把人类劳务同大地的自然禀赋以最优方式配对。政治制度必须看护好那些把可流动的生产要素引向不可流动的生产要素的通道，却不去“组织”它们。
米塞斯坚信经济原则是人类组织世界最理性的基础，同时又对他认定的对手，即民族国家这一政治形式的力量保持高度警觉。对他来说，真正的战争不在各个民族或帝国之间，而在两种人类组织形式——世界经济与民族——之间。
en: For Mises, policy questions were always held to the touchstone of world economic productivity. Similarly, his preferences for democracy over dictatorship, and free labor over slavery, were purely functional. Letting people vote decreased the number of revolutions, and letting people work for a wage made them more productive than they were as human chattel.

The reign of competition matched human labor to the earth’s natural endowments in the most optimal way. Political institutions must caretake the pathways that carry mobile factors of production to immobile ones, without seeking to “organize” them.

Mises believed strongly in economic principles as the most rational basis for human organization of the world while also remaining deeply mindful of the power of what he saw as its adversary—the political form of the nation. For him, the real war was not between individual nations or empires but between the world economy and the nation as forms of human organization.

zh: 倘若较量是在世界经济原则与民族之间展开，那么在米塞斯看来，大战的结局壮了民族一方的声势。哈布斯堡帝国瓦解后，地区地图重绘：保加利亚与罗马尼亚大幅扩张领土；昔日的帝国双头奥地利与匈牙利成为独立的民族国家；波兰、捷克斯洛伐克以及斯洛文尼亚人、克罗地亚人和塞尔维亚人国也在这场重组中建立起来——后者于1922年与塞尔维亚合并，组成新的（多民族的）南斯拉夫国家。用1929年一位经济学家的话说，战后重组“把哈布斯堡王朝治下原已存在的经济有机体切成了碎块”。
奥地利同腹地彻底隔绝，体内又肿胀不堪——塞满了从各省涌来的德语公务员。
en: If the struggle was between the principle of world economy and the nation, then Mises felt the outcome of the Great War had strengthened the hand of the latter. The dissolution of the Habsburg Empire redrew the regional map. Bulgaria and Romania expanded their territory greatly, and the former imperial heads of Austria and Hungary became freestanding nation-states. Formed from whole cloth were Poland, Czechoslovakia, and the State of Slovenes, Croats, and Serbs, which in 1922 merged with Serbia to become the new (multinational) state of Yugoslavia. In the words of one economist in 1929, the postwar reorganization had “sliced into segments the economic organism which existed under the Hapsburgs.”
Austria was entirely cut off from its hinterland and swollen with German-speaking civil servants from the provinces.

children: 〔编者注〕原书此处记为1922年。斯洛文尼亚官方历史资料记载，塞尔维亚人、克罗地亚人和斯洛文尼亚人王国于1918年12月1日在贝尔格莱德宣告成立。
〔编者注〕原书此处记为1922年。斯洛文尼亚官方历史资料记载，塞尔维亚人、克罗地亚人和斯洛文尼亚人王国于1918年12月1日在贝尔格莱德宣告成立。

zh: 1918年之后民族问题的“了结”令米塞斯出离愤怒。问题非但未获解答，反而被推上新高。民族自决原则竟被灾难性地作了经济解读。他1927年愤然指出：“民族自足原则每天都赢得新的支持者。连匈牙利、捷克斯洛伐克这类人口不过数百万的国家，也在试图凭借高关税政策与进口禁令，使自己脱离世界其余部分而独立。”
失去的是哈布斯堡帝国的互补性——它本是多样人群之间分工协作的一个现成样板。同时代人把帝国政治与经济统一体的失落称作“多瑙河之谜”。谜面是：帝国终结之后，如何维系数者互利的经济相互依存的纽带？有人甚至发问，“与其摧毁奥匈国家，让它保持完整岂不更好？”
en: The resolution of the nationalities question after 1918 infuriated Mises. Rather than being answered, the problem had been raised to new heights. The principle of national self-determination had, disastrously, been read economically. He observed bitterly in 1927 that “the principle of national autarky wins new supporters with every day that passes. Even countries with only a few million inhabitants, like Hungary and Czechoslovakia, are attempting, by means of a high tariff policy and prohibitions on imports, to make themselves independent of the rest of the world.”

What had been lost was the complementarity of the Habsburg Empire as a working model of a division of labor among diverse human populations. Contemporaries labeled this loss of the political and economic unity of empire “the riddle of the Danube.” The riddle being: How to maintain mutually beneficial bonds of economic interdependence after the end of empire? Some even asked “whether it was not more desirable to leave the Austro-Hungarian state intact rather than destroy it.”

zh: 罗宾斯本人就在拉帕德的高等国际问题研究院的一次讲座上，把哈布斯堡帝国的终结讲作非殖民化的反面教材，也是给英国敲响的警钟。“战前奥地利、尤其是维也纳的经济组织，是为供应旧奥地利帝国广大领土的需要而组织起来的。倏忽之间，仿佛一夜之间，这个市场的绝大部分被近乎禁绝性的关税隔断。多瑙河流域的地域分工，被民族主义的特殊主义摧毁殆尽。”他提出，解药本应是“某种联邦宪法形式，本可以避免当时迫在眉睫的解体”。
en: In a lecture given at Rappard’s Graduate Institute, Robbins himself described the end of the Habsburg Empire as a negative example of decolonization and a cautionary tale for Britain. “The economic organization of prewar Austria, especially Vienna, was keyed up to supply the needs of the vast area of the old Austrian Empire. Suddenly, as it were overnight, the greater part of this market was cut off by almost prohibitive tariffs. The territorial division of labour of the Danube basin was destroyed by nationalist particularism.” A remedy, he suggested, would have been “some form of federal constitution which would have averted the threatened disintegration.”

zh: 1938年，米塞斯着手起草的正是这样一部联邦宪法，1940年起更全力投入。他希望自己的方案能对冲他眼中凡尔赛、圣日耳曼与特里亚农之后世界的制度性失败。写作地点是他位于纽约市上西区的新居——第96街与西端大道交汇处一套限租公寓，他将在那里度过余生。

他聚焦中欧东部。目睹哈布斯堡与奥斯曼两帝国瓦解后的“无政府状态”，他提议建立一个新的“东方民主联盟”（Eastern Democratic Union，EDU）：地域横跨波罗的海直至亚得里亚海、爱琴海与黑海，自瑞士和意大利的东部边界延至俄国的西部边界。EDU将囊括第一次世界大战后独立的所有国家——从拉脱维亚到南斯拉夫——并纳入德国与意大利境内多民族混居的地区，如西里西亚与阜姆。概而言之，它将“涵盖约70万平方英里土地，生活着约1.2亿人口，通行十七种不同语言”。
en: In 1938 Mises set to work drafting just such a federal constitution, and in 1940 he began to work on it in earnest. He hoped that his proposal would counter what he saw as the institutional failure of the world after Versailles, St. Germain, and Trianon. He wrote from his new home in New York City, a rent-controlled apartment at 96th street and West End Avenue on the Upper West Side where he would spend the rest of his life.

The focus of his work was on East Central Europe. Seeing “anarchy” in the wake of the dissolution of the Habsburg and Ottoman Empires, he proposed a new Eastern Democratic Union (EDU) that would span an enormous swath of territory, from the Baltic to the Adriatic, Aegean, and Black Seas, from the eastern borders of Switzerland and Italy to the western borders of Russia. The EDU would include all nations made independent after the First World War, from Latvia to Yugoslavia, as well as multinational parts of the German and Italian states, such as Silesia and Fiume. In all, it would “include about 700,000 square miles with about 120 million people using seventeen different languages.”

zh: EDU的核心原则，是把经济政策同文化政策截然分开。人民在联盟境内享有完全的行动、贸易与就业自由；联盟由设于维也纳的中央议会统治，元首“或为民选总统，或为世袭君主”。国联将任命首任总统与内阁，日后改由普选投票产生——令人想起委任统治委员会的监护做法。米塞斯1938年写下的那个提案版本，更令人联想起委任统治模式以及国联当年在奥地利实行的财政监督形态——他建议某些行政职位应由“英国人和法国人”永久充任，官方语言则取英语或法语。
早在1920年代，米塞斯就表达对委任统治模式的赞许，写道“必须赋予国际联盟以最高权威，管理所有那些尚无议会政府制度的海外领地”，并呼吁把一切殖民地一律改为委任统治地，作为通往民族自决的过渡。
en: The core principle of the EDU was the separation of economic from cultural policy. People would have total freedom of movement, trade, and employment within the territory, which would be ruled from a centralized parliament in Vienna with an “elected president or a hereditary ruler.” Recalling the tutelary practices of the Mandates Commission, the League of Nations would appoint the initial president and cabinet, to be replaced later by a vote based on universal suffrage. A version of the proposal Mises wrote in 1938 was even more reminiscent of both the mandate model and the form of financial oversight the League practiced in Austria; he suggested that certain administrative positions be permanently filled by “Englishmen and Frenchmen” and that the official language be either English or French.

In the 1920s Mises expressed his approval of the mandates model, writing that “the League of Nations must be given supreme authority in the administration of all those overseas territories in which there is no system of parliamentary government,” calling for all colonies to be turned into mandates as a transition to self-determination.

zh: 只要超国家干预服务于维护一个以自由贸易与私人产权为基的全球资本主义秩序，米塞斯便不反对。1932年奥地利被迫接受国联一笔附带苛刻条件的贷款时，他强调其教育意义：“贷款附带的严苛条件，或可使全体民众豁然醒悟：近年所行的经济政策已把我们逼到这般田地——实在别无出路，只能忍受这笔贷款加诸我们的那种屈从。”
在这个事例中，国联成了毫不迁就的经济理性的传导机制——而这种理性恰恰是红色维也纳的政策表面上肆意践踏的。有了国联贷款条件的约束，“经济早已要求良久——却总被拖延或暗中破坏——的节俭措施，便可尽快见诸实行”。
1944年他说得更为直截：一个改组后的国联的规约“必须包含对每一国家主权权利的刚性限制。凡涉及债务、货币制度、税收及其他重大事项的措施，都必须交由国际裁判机构执掌；而没有一支国际警察力量，这样的计划便无从执行。必须使用强力逼使债务人还债”。
在米塞斯看来，一个良版的国联，完全有能力充当市场无形之手的那副铁手套。
en: Mises was not opposed to supranational intervention as long as it served to preserve a global capitalist order based on free trade and private property. When in 1932 Austria was forced to accept a loan from the League of Nations with punitive conditions attached, he stressed its pedagogic potential: “The severe conditions under the loan may open the eyes of the entire population to the fact that the economic policy that has been followed in recent years has brought us to a situation where we really see no other way out than to accept the sort of subjugation which this loan imposes on us.”

In this case, the League was the mechanism of an unflinching economic rationality ostensibly flouted by the policies of Red Vienna. With the compunction of League conditionality, the “measures of frugality that the economy has required for a long time—but which have always been delayed or sabotaged—be put into effect as quickly as possible.”

In 1944 he was even more forthright, writing that the covenant for a renewed League would “have to include a rigid limitation of sovereign rights of every country. Measures which affect debts, the money systems, taxations, and other important matters have to be administered by international tribunals, and without an international police force such a plan could not be carried out. Force must be used to make debtors pay.”
For Mises, a good version of the League had the capacity to act as an iron glove for the invisible hand of the market.

zh: 米塞斯的EDU方案，意在欧洲东半部把国联之梦的一个强势版本付诸实施，其要诀在于彻底贬低拉帕德所说的“国家主权教条”。
他解决民族问题的方案颇具新意：允许民族身份的全套行头继续存在——旗帜、国歌、邮票，以及“各成员国铸造的、带民族徽记的硬币”。
人民可自由发展本民族文化，并在境外加以代表。教育这个棘手难题——旧哈布斯堡帝国的一大焦点问题——将通过一项方案加以解决，而该方案径直预告了后来美国新自由主义者与保守主义者的诉求：一切学校概归私立，公民则获发一笔今之所谓“教育券”形态的专款用于教育支出。
凡有语言群体人口足以成学之处，任何地方都可设立学校。
en: Mises’s EDU proposal sought to realize a strong version of the League dream for the eastern half of Europe by radically downgrading what Rappard called the “dogma of national sovereignty.”

His solution to the nationality problem was novel. He permitted the persistence of all the accouterments of nationhood, including flags, anthems, postage stamps, and “coins of every member state, coined with the national emblems.”

People would be free to develop their own national culture and represent it abroad. The thorny problem of education, a major issue in the old Habsburg Empire, would be remedied through a scheme that directly anticipated the latter-day demands of U.S. neoliberals and conservatives. All schools would be private, and citizens would be granted a lump sum in the form of what are now called vouchers to spend on education.
Linguistic groups could establish schools anywhere in the territory there was a critical mass to form one.

zh: 米塞斯把EDU作为压轴一章收入1944年出版的《全能政府》（Omnipotent Government），为其“民族会变迁，并不系于任何特定领土”的见解赋予制度形式。
在他看来，这也一并解决了困扰国联的少数民族问题。其模式中最触目的，是可见性问题。联盟各成员国拥有主权国家的全部外在标志，但这份主权徒为观赏之物，已被中央政府的权威架空净尽。然而一位到访者所见将止于表面，看不到底下的经济联盟。“他看不见EDU，”米塞斯写道，“也没有机会碰到EDU的代理人。”

与第2章讨论过的经济领域乃隐形之域的理念一脉相承，开放经济的政府将深藏于公众视线之外。为人所见的，只有色彩斑斓却毫无实权的民族政策的代表。双重政府将充作超国家联邦的样板：自由贸易与劳工自由流动由一个强大的中央国家统辖——此为第一性的；在此之下，去中心化的民族制度与文化制度可以流转变化——此为第二性的。米塞斯为20世纪重造的哈布斯堡帝国，首先是一个隐形治理的经济政府，其次是一个可见却去势的诸民族政府。
en: Mises’s EDU, which he included as the culminating chapter of his 1944 book
gave institutional form to his understanding of nations as protean and unmoored to any particular territory.

It also, to his mind, solved the problem of minorities that had bedeviled the League of Nations. Most striking in his model is the question of visibility. The constituent nations of the union would bear all the outward marks of sovereignty, yet this sovereignty would be ornamental, undermined wholly by the authority of the central government. A visitor to the territory, though, would see only the surface and not the underlying economic union. “He will not see the EDU,” Mises wrote, “he will not have the opportunity to meet the agents of the EDU.”

Consistent with the idea of an invisible realm of the economic discussed in Chapter 2, the government of the open economy would remain hidden from the public eye. Only the colorful—and powerless—representatives of national policy would be seen. A double government would serve as a model of supranational federation. That there would be free trade and free movement of labor overseen by a strong central state was primary, allowing for a shifting landscape of decentralized national and cultural institutions that would remain secondary. Mises’s Habsburg Empire reborn for the twentieth century was an invisible government of the economy first, and a visible government of neutered nations second.

zh: 1945年，哈耶克对米塞斯的构想表示赞同。他表示“对把（哈布斯堡帝国）拆成九个独立民族国家是否果真妥当，心存疑虑”，代之以一项提议：把各国聚合为一个联邦，在那里“为了某个中央组织的利益，限制民族国家的权力”。权力日后还可以下放，最乐观的情形，是出现“一个类似东欧瑞士的东西”。
这与日内瓦学派（Geneva School）受约束的民族主义的原则一脉相通：关键正在于限制国家主权。决不能听任民族国家享有其完全独立。
en: In 1945 Hayek endorsed Mises’s idea. Expressing “some doubt as to whether the splitting of [the Habsburg Empire] up into nine independent national states was altogether a fortunate solution,” he proposed instead the gathering of the nations into a federation in which “we limited the power of the national States in the interests of some central organization.” Power may later be devolved, leading in the most optimistic case to “something like an Eastern European Switzerland.”
Consistent with the Geneva School principle of constrained nationalism, it was the limiting of national sovereignty that was key. The nation-state must not be allowed its full independence.

zh: 勒普克、所有权与统治权
哈耶克、罗宾斯与米塞斯提出了1930—1940年代最激进的新自由主义联邦愿景。他们的设计为博恩所称的自由贸易与资本自由流动之隐形经济帝国提供制度护卫。他们的合作者勒普克着墨较少，但1942年也写道，必须建立“真正的世界联合，其结构必须是名副其实联邦式的，即由区域与大陆的次级集团层层合成”。
他把自己新近钟爱的瑞士放大到全球尺度外推，想象一个民族国家只充当“州”（canton）的世界。
1945年春，勒普克在一本书中重拾联邦主题。该书结尾几页暗示：德意志问题的答案，在于把俾斯麦式国家分权化、拆解为联邦结构。
哈耶克为该书作序，称许勒普克的方案。他写道，自由贸易联邦将剥夺德国“作为其支撑战争的经济能力根基的工农自给自足”，逼使她“在自己能为世界繁荣作出最大贡献的领域实现高度专业化，同时使其自身繁荣系于与他国的持续交换”。只要自由贸易有保障，世界市场的需求便是“唯一一种无法被暗中规避的约束”。
联邦再度被肯认为政治上的当然推论——与之相对的经济端，是贸易与资本流动那据称匿名的规训性秩序力量。
en: Hayek, Robbins, and Mises offered the most radical visions of neoliberal federation in the 1930s and 1940s. Their designs offered institutional protection for what Bonn called the invisible economic empire of free trade and free capital mobility. Their collaborator Röpke went into less detail but wrote similarly in 1942 of “the necessity for a true world union, whose structure must be genuinely federal, i.e. composed of regional and continental sub-groups.”
He extrapolated from his newly beloved Switzerland to the scale of the global to imagine a world in which nation-states had the function of “cantons.”

Röpke returned to the idea of federation in the spring of 1945 in a book that suggested in its concluding pages that the answer to the German Question was the decentralization of the Bismarckian state into a federal structure.

Hayek commended Röpke’s proposal in the book’s introduction. A free-trade federation, he observed, would deny Germany the “industrial and agricultural self-sufficiency on which her economic war-potential rested” and drive it “to a high degree of specialisation in the fields where she could make the greatest contribution to the prosperity of the world, and at the same time become dependent for her own prosperity on the continued exchange with other countries.” As long as free trade was secured, world market demand would act as “the only kind of control which could not be secretly evaded.”
Federation was once again endorsed as the political corollary to the putatively anonymous economic disciplinary ordering force of trade and capital flows.

zh: 勒普克1939年提议在日内瓦开设一门名为“国际联邦经济学”的课程，但1945年以前，他并未拿出与米塞斯、罗宾斯或哈耶克同样具体的超国家方案。
即便在各国重造秩序的思想热情最为高涨之际，他也只是轻蔑地插话，讥讽“四面八方正在炮制的建立世界国家共同体的种种宏大计划”。

与此同时，他1945年之前的著作为我们理解新自由主义者帝国之后的世界想象提供了关键洞见。在1942年出版的《国际经济解体》——1936年安纳西会议发端之事业的集大成之作——中，勒普克提出一套与罗宾斯、哈耶克神似的动态：他论证说，国际秩序之败坏，源自因大众民主而获得权力的特殊利益集团所提出的种种扭曲市场秩序的要求。他在沃尔特·李普曼座谈会上如此概括这一点：“只说经济民族主义源于领导人智力不足，是不够的。搞民族主义政策的是经济利益与职业群体；正是特殊利益在溶解国家。”
en: Although Röpke proposed a course titled “Economics of International Federation” in Geneva in 1939, he delivered no supranational plans as concrete as those of Mises, Robbins, or Hayek before 1945.

Even at the high point of intellectual excitement for plans of international reordering, he delivered dismissive asides about the “lofty plans for a world community of states that are being developed from all quarters.”
At the same time, his work before 1945 offers key insights into the neoliberal imagination of a world after empire. In his 1942 book

which was the culmination of the project begun at Annecy in 1936, Röpke laid out a dynamic reminiscent of Robbins and Hayek by arguing that the international order had been undermined by the distorting demands of special interests empowered by popular democracy. He summarized this point at the Walter Lippmann Colloquium when he said, “It is not enough to say that economic nationalism is the result of a lack of intelligence among leaders; it is economic interests and professional groups that engage in nationalist policy, it is special interests that dissolve the State.”

zh: 勒普克的解释比后来出现的公共选择理论早了几十年。他追随德国秩序自由主义者瓦尔特·欧肯与弗朗茨·伯姆当时的论述，把经济民族主义解释为一种政治策略的产物：民选官员拥抱多元主义，用“政治分肥”收买选票——向利益集团许诺补贴、岗位、加薪、税收好处与关税，换取其政治支持。第一次世界大战后男性普选权的普及使这一动力开足马力、过度运转，把各国变成喧嚷的特殊利益待分的“赃物”（Beute）。民族经济背着贸易保护、高工资、社会福利的层层诉求，变得迟钝，对全球需求的推拉失去应答。大众民主之下，政府一心要同时讨好国内所有群体，反而虚弱分裂。各国转而用闭关自足的宏图与充分就业的狂言加倍补偿。它们愈发偏离自己从经济角度看最擅长的本分：工业国保护农业，农业国刺激工业。
en: Anticipating public choice theory by decades, Röpke followed the contemporary work of German ordoliberals Walter Eucken and Franz Böhm by explaining economic nationalism as an outcome of a political strategy by which elected officials embraced pluralism to buy votes with pork—promising subsidies, jobs, wage increases, tax benefits, and tariffs to interest groups in exchange for their political support. The spread of universal male suffrage after the First World War pushed this dynamic into overdrive, turning states into “loot”

to be divided up among clamoring special interests. Burdened with demands for trade protection, high wages, and social benefits, national economies became sluggish and unresponsive to the push and pull of global demand. Under conditions of mass democracy, the state became weak and internally divided as it sought to please all domestic groups at once. Governments overcompensated with visions of autarky and self-sufficiency and wild promises of full employment. States moved further away from what they did best from an economic point of view as industrial countries protected agriculture and agricultural countries stimulated industry.

zh: 在勒普克看来，特殊利益与大众正把民族国家当作武器，摧毁世界经济的统一，动摇人类繁荣的根基。在日内瓦高等国际问题研究院的就职演说中，他摆出论点：“国家尺度的计划与国际尺度的失序，不只是并行的现象，而是因果相连的现象。”
世界经济的原则与民族的原则直接对立。勒普克追随欧肯，把利益集团索取经济好处的行为称为经济领域的“政治化”（Politisierung）。
罗宾斯也用这个德语词来描述国家计划对国际经济关系的效应。
早在1932年，欧肯就用该词谈论国家如何渐成“一个经济国家……其行动听命于经济集团的意志，而这些集团把它多少当作工具来使用”。
欧肯与勒普克都谈到经济与国家关系的“退化”。欧肯写道，在“世界的民主化以及它在各个民族身上释放出的魔性力量”的压力之下，经济政策“消融为一堆措施的杂拌，每一项都连着各个经济权力集团的意愿，见不出统摄的思想或意志，只见出全然的没有体系（Systemlosigkeit）”。
en: Röpke saw special interests and the masses using nation-states as weapons to destroy the unity of the world economy and undermine the basis of human prosperity. In his inaugural lecture at the Graduate Institute in Geneva, he laid out his thesis that “planning on a national scale and the disorder on the international scale are not only parallel, but causally connected phenomena.”
The principle of the world economy was directly at odds with that of the nation. Röpke followed Eucken in referring to the demands of interest groups for economic favors as the “politicization”
of the economic sphere.
Robbins used the German term to describe the effect of national planning on international economic relations.

Eucken used the word as early as 1932 to talk about how the state was gradually becoming an “economy state … whose actions become dependent on the will of economic groups that use it more or less as a tool.”

Eucken and Röpke both referred to a “degeneration” of the relationship between economy and state. Eucken wrote that, under the pressure of “the democratization of the world and the unleashing of demonic forces in the nations that it brought with it,” economic policy “dissolves into a mass of measures, each one connected to the wishes of various economic power groups, and betrays a total lack of system
rather than a unifying thought or will.”

zh: 在欧肯与勒普克的理解中，经济民族主义既非非理性的狂热，也非心理操纵的产物，而是国内各个群体合乎理性的图谋：运用自己的政治影响——选举的与非选举的——从国家那里攫取最大化的经济好处。顶住这种压力，单凭劝说或更高明的论辩做不到；这需要国家下定决心并采取行动。勒普克1942年用军事比喻描述这一任务：“只有先攻下‘新政’的堡垒，荡涤干净‘成熟经济’‘赤字开支’‘充分就业’的种种学说，并把大型利益集团——农场主与工会皆在其中——对权力的巨量滥用堵截住，美国保护主义政策的堡垒才能被攻克。”
要抵消经济民族主义之效——要遏制农场主和工会的权力——就非得把国家从大众手里夺回来不可。第6章将会看到，欧肯与其合作者弗朗茨·伯姆把这称作创设一部“经济宪法”的需要。这个短语径直取自保守派法学家卡尔·施密特（Carl Schmitt）。他们把经济宪法界定为“关于国民经济生活秩序的一项总体政治决断”。
en: In Eucken and Röpke’s understanding, economic nationalism was not an irrational hysteria or an artifact of psychological manipulation but a rational attempt by the diverse groups within a nation to use their political influence—electoral and otherwise—to secure the maximum economic advantages from the state. Pushing back against this pressure would not be achieved simply through persuasion or superior argument. It would take an act of state will. Röpke used a martial metaphor to describe the task in 1942, writing that “the fortress of American protectionist policy can only be taken after the fortress of the New Deal has been taken, and after all of the theories of the ‘mature economy,’ of ‘deficit spending’ and ‘full employment’ have been cleared out, and the monstrous misuse of power of the large interest groups, including farmers and labor unions, has been dammed.”

To counteract the effects of economic nationalism—and dam the power of the farmers and the labor unions—it was necessary to take the state back from the masses. As we will see in Chapter 6, Eucken and his collaborator Franz Böhm referred to this as the need to create an “economic constitution.” They took the phrase directly from the conservative jurist Carl Schmitt, and described the economic constitution as a “total political decision about the ordering of national economic life.”

zh: 秩序自由主义者欧肯与伯姆很少留意国际尺度，勒普克却把他们的洞见向上放大，提出以强国家为道，在世界经济秩序历经帝国末路之后加以挽救。在李普曼座谈会讨论殖民主义时，勒普克说得有些隐晦：“我们必须研究帝国主义政策与私人企业的角色之间实际存在的关系，问一问：对于一个良序的制度而言，要紧之处是否在于把广泛介入改为在较窄范围内加强管理。”
这一对立何所指，可见于他写给研讨会另一位与会者马塞尔·范泽兰（Marcel Van Zeeland）的一封信：
en: Ordoliberals Eucken and Böhm paid little attention to the international scale, but Röpke scaled their insights upward, proposing a strong state as the way to salvage the world economic order after the end of empire. In a discussion of colonialism at the Lippmann Colloquium, Röpke said, somewhat cryptically, “We must study the actual existing relations between imperialist policy and the role of private enterprise and ask if the essential point is whether, for a well-ordered system, extensive management could not be replaced by intensive management.”
What he might mean by this opposition is made clearer in a letter he wrote to Marcel Van Zeeland, another attendee of the colloquium:

zh: 论及我对“强国家”（le gouvernment qui gouverne）的看法，我或许比您本人还要“更法西斯”（faschist

）一些——因为我确实愿意看到全部经济政策决断集中握在一个完全自主、生机勃勃的国家之手，而不被任何法团主义式的多元权力机构削弱。……我所寻求的国家之力，在于其经济政策的强度（intensity），而非广度（extensiveness）。这样一个国家的宪法—法律构造应当如何设计，本身即是另一问题，对此我并无独门药方奉上。我赞同您的看法：议会民主的旧公式已被证明无用。人们必须习惯一个事实：除了议会式民主，还有总统式、威权式，甚至——
（说来骇人）——专制式的民主。
en: It is possible that in my opinion of the “strong state” (le gou
I am even “more fascist” [faschist

] than you yourself, because I would indeed like to see all economic policy decisions concentrated in the hands of a fully independent and vigorous state weakened by no pluralist authorities of a corporatist kind. … I seek the strength of the state in the
not the

of its economic policies. How the constitutional legal structure of such a state should be designed is a question in and of itself for which I have no patent recipe to offer. I share your opinion that the old formulas of parliamentary democracy have proven themselves useless. People must get used to the fact that there is also presidential, authoritarian, yes even—
[horrible to say]—dictatorial democracy.

zh: 勒普克在此暗示了一种可能：对付大众民主所滋生的经济政策退化，威权主义的政府形式或许必要——至少并非不可设想。与罗宾斯、哈耶克一样，在他看来，唯有这样一个强有力、不受特殊利益左右的权威，才能护住全球自由交换的条件——1914年以前，这一条件由帝国制度配以金本位代为维系。
en: Röpke floated here the possibility that forms of authoritarian government may be necessary—or are at least conceivable—to counteract the degeneration of economic policy produced by mass democracy. As with Robbins and Hayek, only such a powerful authority freed from influence by special interests could protect the conditions of free global exchange that the system of empires paired with the gold standard had done until 1914.

zh: 如导论所见，勒普克借罗马法贡献了一对有用的范畴，用以说明必须依靠强国家才能重建的那种秩序。在一篇写于1934年的短文里，他主张正确理解之下的资本主义本身即反帝国主义，并指出地缘政治学说常常混淆统治权（imperium）与所有权（
）两原则。
1942年他加以发挥，说经济民族主义的一条信条便是“政治上的支配（imperium）乃经济上的榨取（
）所必需”。
在所有权——有学者称之为“对物的统治”——与统治权——“对人的统治”——这组范畴里，勒普克为自由主义世界观备下了法律概念。
“统治权与所有权确是两回事，”他继续说道，“但唯在一个自由主义的世界里才是如此。在这样的世界里，政治边界几无经济意义可言；世界市场大体上是一块统一之地，无论边界与国籍，人人享有的买卖机会几乎均等。”
勒普克在这里把一层意思讲白了。欧肯曾把它表述为“国家领域与经济领域的自由主义分立”——第一次世界大战及此后的经济民族主义打破了这种分立。
en: As we saw in the Introduction, Röpke offered useful categories from Roman law to help explain the order that the strong state would be necessary to reestablish. In a short 1934 article contending that, properly understood, capitalism itself was anti-imperialist, he argued that the doctrine of geopolitics frequently confused the principles of imperium and
He elaborated in 1942, saying that it was one of the contentions of economic nationalism that “political domination (imperium) is necessary for economic exploitation (
In the categories of
, or what one scholar calls “rule over things,” and imperium, “rule over people,” Röpke offered legal concepts for the liberal worldview.
and

are indeed two separate things,” he continued, “but only in a liberal world.
