In such a world political boundaries are of little economic significance, the world market being more or less a uniform one with practically equal buying and selling opportunities for everybody, regardless of boundaries and nationality.”

Röpke made explicit here what Eucken discussed as “the liberal separation of the spheres of the state and the economy” that was undone by the First World War and the economic nationalism that followed.

zh: 勒普克的范畴提示：资本主义会生出一个双重世界。理想的新自由主义秩序将维系两个全球领域之间的平衡。这对范畴给了无形者以实体。双重世界的划界，与新自由主义者设想的双重政府丝丝入扣：一个是经济与所有权的世界，与另一个民族的世界并世而立。在理想的自由世界里，谁也不会把地图上的线错认为所有权世界里有实在意味的标记。强国家——不为民主影响的压力所动——将必不可少，以守护世界的经济宪法。1937年，沃尔特·李普曼（Walter Lippmann）写道：“良序社会没有建筑设计图。也没有蓝图。”
他大大借力于米塞斯与哈耶克的著述——两年之前，哈耶克曾写道：“就凭‘计划’来改善我们经济制度的运转，我们在理智上并无这个装备。”
讽刺的是，新自由主义者对这一洞见的回应，是即刻着手制作设计图、蓝图与计划——不过不在民族国家的尺度，而在区域与世界的尺度。哈耶克、罗宾斯与米塞斯的联邦方案，都是预防性的制度设计：以制度从设计上抑制特殊利益诉求的发生。而在最须抑制的特殊利益清单上，民族本身赫然在列。
en: Röpke’s categories suggested that capitalism produce a doubled world. The ideal neoliberal order would maintain the balance between these two global spheres. These categories gave substance to the invisible. The delineation of the double world corresponded with the double government envisioned by the neoliberals: there would be one world of the economy and ownership, coexisting with another world of nations. In the ideal liberal world, nobody would mistake the lines on the map for meaningful marks in the world of dominium. A strong state—resistant to the pressures of democratic influence—would be necessary to safeguard the economic constitution of the world. In 1937 Walter Lippmann wrote that “the Good Society has no architectural design. There are no blueprints.”
He leaned heavily on the work of Mises and Hayek, who had written two years earlier that “we are not intellectually equipped to improve the working of our economic system by ‘planning.’ ”

Ironically, the response of the neoliberals to this insight was to immediately begin creating designs, blueprints, and plans, not at the scale of the nation but at the scale of the region and the world. The federation plans of Hayek, Robbins, and Mises were designed as prophylaxis—using institutions to suppress the emergence of special interest demands by design. One of the most critical special interests to suppress was the nation itself.

zh: 我在本章中论证，新自由主义部分地诞生于对国家主权的批判。在新自由主义者眼中，民族是流转不定、临时权宜的，对这块那块土地并不主张什么权利。民族造就的政治认同，破坏了经济领域与政治领域之间的平衡——民主国家的参与者们肆意把政府预算变成中饱私囊的蓄水池。第2章中我论证，新自由主义是对相信人可以无所不能的狂妄的批判。本章我又论证，它同时还是对另一桩他们眼中的人类狂妄盛举的批判——那种以为社会能够为自身创制法律的信念。
en: I have argued in this chapter that neoliberalism was born in part as a critique of national sovereignty. To neoliberals, nations were shifting, provisional, without claims on this or that patch of earth. The political identifications produced by nations led to a disruption of the balance between the economic and the political spheres as participants in democracies recklessly turned government budgets into reservoirs of personal enrichment. In Chapter 2 I argued that neoliberalism was a critique of the arrogance of a belief in omnipotence. Here I have argued that it also was a critique of what they saw as another colossal act of human arrogance—the belief that societies can create their own laws.

zh: 新自由主义者拿什么来对抗民族国家？不只是世界经济，还有个人。1931年，LSE经济学家威廉·H.·哈特（William H. Hutt）铸出“消费者主权”（consumer sovereignty）一词。哈耶克1935年采其说，博恩1933年已用之。在哈特那里，它是应对民族主权要求的解方。顾名思义，拥有主权的不是代议机关所代表的民族国家，而是国家内部的个人。哈耶克写道，社会主义者自上而下配置资源，所要求的正是“废除消费者主权”。
他追随奥地利先贤卡尔·门格尔（Carl Menger），把经济中真正的创造力量看成那些接受或拒绝价格的人——而拒绝一个价格，就生产出一个新价格。正当民族国家日益贪婪地申领一种所谓“主权”之时，哈耶克把这个概念从民族国家手里偷走，转交给作为个人的消费者。民族自决正成为全球时髦口号之际，他重申了个人消费者自决的理念。
en: What did the neoliberals pose against the nation? Not only the world economy but the individual. In 1931 LSE economist William H. Hutt coined the term “consumer sovereignty.” Hayek adopted the term in 1935, and Bonn used it in 1933. For Hutt it was a solution to the demands of national sovereignty. As the term implied, it was not the nation-state represented by legislatures that was sovereign but the individual within it. Hayek wrote that socialists, who allocated resources from above, were demanding the “abrogation of the sovereignty of the consumer.”

He followed his Austrian predecessor Carl Menger by seeing the true creative force in the economy as those who either accept or reject a price, and by rejecting a price, produce a new one. At a time when nation-states were claiming more and more of something called “sovereignty,” Hayek pickpocketed the term and reassigned it from the nation to the individual consumer. As national self-determination was becoming the buzzword worldwide, he reasserted the notion of individual consumer self-determination.

zh: 然而，国家仿佛消散，只剩拥有主权的一个个消费者，终究只是一种幻象。对哈耶克来说，个人消费者主权唯赖联邦的上层建筑方有可能。打击经济与货币民族主义，并没有把权力下放给个人，而是把主权分给两个层级——下及消费者，上归超级国家。1930与1940年代，新自由主义知识人把去民族化当作一项纲领来追求：用它取代帝国，驯服势头正盛的民族的破坏性力量。针对大众民主、无产阶级化与经济民族主义这三位一体的难题，新自由主义者炮制的解方是政府的去民族化。在关于世界政府与联邦制的流行讨论的诸变体之中，哈耶克、罗宾斯与米塞斯都提出了他们有时所称的“双重政府”：经济事务的管理与文化事务分离，经济则经由一种超国家形态而去政治化。
en: The apparent dissolution of the state to the granular level of the sovereign consumer, however, was always an illusion. For Hayek, individual consumer sovereignty was only made possible by the superstructure of the federation. Attacking economic and monetary nationalism did not devolve power down to the individual. Instead it split sovereignty—down to the consumer and up to the superstate. In the 1930s and 1940s neoliberal intellectuals pursued denationalization as a program, something to replace empire and tame the disruptive forces of the ascendant nation. The solution that neoliberals concocted to the joined problems of mass democracy, proletarianization, and economic nationalism was the denationalization of government. In variations on the widespread discussion of world government and federalism, Hayek, Robbins, and Mises all proposed what they sometimes called “double government,” by which administration of economic issues would be separated from cultural issues and the economy would be depoliticized through a supranational state form.

zh: 战后国际秩序虽在设计时几乎没有、或全然没有新自由主义者本人的参与，却实现了双重政府的若干要求。民族主权原则固然胜出（有时要经过非殖民化的长久斗争），世界的大部分地区却仍处在一个由国际货币基金组织（IMF）与关税与贸易总协定（General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade，简称关贸总协定，GATT）监督的经济框架之内。IMF与世界银行一同创建于1944年，帮助维持了相对稳定的汇率以及此币兑彼币的可兑换性。1947年签署的关贸总协定朝着自由贸易的愿景努力，用协定本身的话说，目标是“削减关税及其他贸易壁垒，并消除国际贸易中的歧视待遇”。与此同时，这种经济世界政府的表象，从新自由主义的立场看仍大有欠缺。关贸总协定开篇即把“确保充分就业”列为目标——而充分就业正是新自由主义者的头号梦魇之一。并且，如果说IMF的部分设计初衷是让各单个国家承受世界市场的规训，它的创新之处却恰恰在于允许各国自行屏蔽国际投机与所谓热钱流动的反复无常。政策自主性——为福利国家目标量身裁衣地制定经济政策的能力——正是所谓布雷顿森林体系的标志。
en: Although designed with little or no input from the neoliberals themselves, the international postwar order realized some of the demands of double government. Even as the principle of national sovereignty triumphed (sometimes after long struggles of decolonization), most of the world remained within an economic framework overseen by the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT). Created in 1944 along with the World Bank, the IMF helped ensure relatively stable exchange rates and the possibility of converting money from one currency into another. The GATT, signed in 1947, worked toward the free-trade vision and, in the words of the agreement, the “reduction of tariffs and other barriers to trade and to the elimination of discriminatory treatment in international commerce.” At the same time, this semblance of economic world government left much to be desired from a neoliberal standpoint. The GATT agreement began by stating its goal as “ensuring full employment”—one of the primary bugbears of neoliberals. And if the IMF was designed, in part, to expose individual nations to the discipline of the world market, its innovation was in permitting nations to insulate themselves against the vagaries of international speculation and so-called hot money flows. Policy autonomy—the ability to tailor economic policy toward the goal of the welfare state—was the hallmark of what was called the Bretton Woods system.

zh: 布雷顿森林体系实现了新自由主义梦想的部分内容，同时在其他方面又彻底偏离。更令人忧虑的是，在全球居主导地位的机构从国际联盟变为联合国。联合国以一国一票为原则，必将引致经济活动的政治化——而这正是新自由主义的联邦愿景力图防止的。门户开放的大英帝国在一个门户开放的世界联邦中借尸还魂的幻想，将被全球北方的特殊利益集团所阻挠，在全球南方受到的阻力更大，那里新兴国家追求的是越出委任统治监护模式的民族自决。1945年之后，世界政府话语中危害最大的增添项之一，便是人权观念的扩张。如我们将看到的，新自由主义者将助力这样一场战役：遏制对社会权与经济权的要求，并制度化一套平行的全球体制——在其中，投资者与公司（而非公民或难民）才是权利主体的典型。
en: The Bretton Woods system realized parts of the neoliberal dream while also deviating radically in other ways. Of more concern was the transformation of the predominant world authority from the League of Nations to the United Nations. Based on the principle of one-country-one-vote, the UN would usher in the very politicization of economic activity that neoliberal visions of federation sought to prevent. The fantasy of the rebirth of the Open Door British empire in an Open Door world federation would be spoiled by special interests in the Global North and even more so in the Global South, where new nations sought self-determination beyond the supervisory mandate model. One of the most damaging additions to the language of world government after 1945 was the expansion of the idea of human rights. As we will see, neoliberals would aid in the campaign to contain demands for social and economic rights and to institutionalize a parallel global regime in which the investor and the corporation—and not the citizen or refugee—was the paradigmatic rights-bearing subject.
